title: Case Resolution Engineer
description:
Headquarters:  Canada - Remote
 

 Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. 
 Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers. 
 We're hiring Support Engineers to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but trace them back to the line of product code causing them, ship the fix that resolves the customer's problem immediately, and partner with senior engineers on the cases complex enough to need them. 
 You might be the recent engineering grad who spent a summer at a busy front desk, in a popular restaurant, or on a support line because you like people as much as you like problems, and who's been quietly automating things nobody asked you to fix since your first CS class. Or, you might be the person who leads team projects, tinkers with the dashboards, automations, or workflows so automatically that colleagues assume you are an engineer even if you aren’t. If that sounds like you, this role turns that problem-solving instinct into your core responsibility. 
 As a Support Engineer, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen. 
  Role and Responsibilities  
 
  Synthesize and share customer insights.  Surface patterns from your cases in weekly and monthly reports, participate in Product and Engineering discussions with what you're learning, and mentor Support Team members on AI workflows, scripting, and SQL queries. 
  Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases.  Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter. 
  Build and own AI quality.  Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations and scripts, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain. 
 
  What success looks like in your first 6 months  
 
 Delivered solutions that reduced case volume by 10% or eliminated recurring issue categories, with measurable customer impact (e.g., CSAT, reduction in case reopens)

About the Company

Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore.

Working hand in hand with Business Development and the Proposal & Project Manager, you shape the technical solution that qualifies an opportunity and wins it, building on proven product and technology solutions from Engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities.

Once contracts are won, you carry your mission concept into execution. As a founding technical hire, you own the analysis that underpins every German proposal and delivery.

You will design and implement core components of our end‑to‑end autonomy stack — from perception and prediction to path planning and vehicle control. Your work enables reliable operation of unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) in challenging environments, including GNSS‑denied areas, off‑road terrain, and multi‑vehicle convoying.

You will collaborate closely with experts across software, hardware, and mission systems to integrate the right sensors, algorithms, and architectures into robust field‑ready platforms. Your contributions directly support Quantum‑Systems’ mission to set the benchmark for multi‑domain autonomous systems.

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

You'll design how it works, lead our agency partner, and craft the stories, moments and relationships that make people pay attention to Yubo. The role covers everyday consumer stories, corporate communications, and handling sensitive issues or crises when they arise. To start, you'll focus on the US, UK and France, with room to grow from there.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (ML Systems) - Paris
description:
You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.

This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

What success looks like

Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

What you’ll be doing

  • Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference

  • Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed

  • Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes

  • Managing capacity with our cloud providers

  • Debugging failures in GPUs, Linux, storage and networking

The first year

By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

Who you’ll work with

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure

title: Marketing & Comunication
description:
About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

ROLE
We are looking for the person who will build marketing and communications at Bleu Robotics, starting from a blank page. Our ambitions is huge, and your job is to make sure the right people know about us: industrial companies, robot makers and talents.We’re looking for someone who has done the 0 to 1 before and knows how to hack it.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Shape how we talk about the company, with the founders

  • Bring our brand to life across web, social, video and events

  • Help the right people discover us: press, conferences, partners

title: Research Lead, Predictive Oncology
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Lead - Predictive Oncology, to build and lead a research programme to improve the translational capabilities of Orakl Oncology’s platform, and to provide the scientific backbone of O-Predict, Orakl’s predictive solutions.

You will own O-Predict's long-term scientific roadmap, choose the questions we pursue, and lead the work needed to answer them. The opportunity combines access to Orakl's experimental and molecular data, clinical information where available, and the ability to shape future data generation with our experimental and clinical collaborators.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a DevOps Engineer at Namespace, you'll build and operate the infrastructure that makes this performance possible. You'll own the compute, storage, and networking behind every build our customers run, keeping the platform fast, reliable, and cost-effective as we accelerate more companies around the world.

title: Embedded Engineer

Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.

title: Senior Agent Platform Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
We help companies get compensation right.

What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. They simply have no choice but to rely on poor data and unsophisticated tools for their pay decisions. That’s why we created Ravio.

We help many of the world’s most innovative and ambitious companies build stronger teams and reach their goals through better compensation. Our real-time data platform brings compensation into the modern age, tracking the market across all compensation types from salary to equity and benefits.

Ravio is growing fast, which means you can too. We’ve established ourselves as the European leader in our space serving more than 1,200 clients, and now have our sights set on becoming the global go to place for compensation data and tools for managing compensation.

Joining a startup and scaling it into a global product is one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences a career can offer. If that sounds exciting to you, you’re in the right place.


The role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team and play a major role in our technical leadership during a significant platform shift.

Ravio is moving from a traditional SaaS posture to a platform built around agents - parent agents fronting our compensation data, specialist agents underneath, durable workflows, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. You’ll own architecture and technical design across the stack: the customer-facing web app, the agentic platform, and the shared infrastructure connecting them.

As an Account Executive, you’ll join our Sales team and run full-cycle sales across your territory in EMEA. This is your chance to help build a category-defining company at an exciting point in its evolution. You’ll develop new relationships with HR and Reward leaders and establish Ravio as the go-to compensation insights platform in your territory. description:

Join the go-to-market team at a Series A HR technology startup and help build its outbound pipeline. You will connect with HR and Finance leaders at growing companies, using modern sales tools to support the team's next stage of growth and develop toward an Account Executive role.

What You'll Do

  • Strong cold-calling skills and experience engaging senior HR, Finance, and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email outreach tools, and AI tools such as ChatGPT.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary is £40,000 to £43,000 GBP annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

How you’ll fix communication in healthcare as a Senior Communications & PR Lead (12m FTC)

At Accurx, we’ve supported thousands of healthcare organisations to deliver care for over 60 million patients. We’re used by 98% of GP practices and in 68% of NHS Trusts - that’s over 200,000 NHS staff each week.

As the Senior Communications & PR Lead at Accurx (12m FTC), you’ll drive brand awareness and interest through top of funnel content to shape Accurx’s reputation across the care settings we operate in and amongst our key audiences of NHS senior decision-makers and policymakers, with a particular focus on secondary care (acute and community & mental health hospitals).

You’ll use data to measure PR effectiveness, and iterate on your strategy aligned with company goals.

title: Senior Platform Engineer

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

title: Product Engineer - ElevenCreative Enterprise
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first:

title: Forward Deployed Scientist
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You work with customers to help them design better proteins and get more out of every experiment, sitting between their design models and our lab.

In London, a large share of that work is with ARIA. Adaptyv has been selected for ARIA's second cohort of Activation Partners, and ARIA, the UK's Advanced Research + Invention Agency, is funding our new automated lab in London: the UK's first AI-native automated wet lab.

description:
Let’s fix hospitality, for good.

Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built Nory.

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer
description:
THE LAST FRONTIER

Arctic Research and Development (ARD) was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE

ARD is growing and we’re looking for a Junior Mechanical Engineer to support the design, build and deployment of our ruggedized hardware products - from-field ready energy systems to autonomous surface and subsurface platforms.

You'll join our mechanical engineering team, which designs, builds and tests the hardware that has to operate reliably in the Arctic. You'll report to our Lead Mechanical Engineer and work closely with our Mechanical Engineer and CTO. You'll start hands-on, building and testing units, then feed what you learn back into design updates. Within your first 6-12 months, your work will let us build and test properly, and expand bandwidth to launch further products in parallel.

title: Embedded Control Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering,

title: Senior Radiochemist
description:
ABOUT US

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, Java)
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we've been building that knowledge for over 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we're also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax advisors don't just get an answer, but an answer they're willing to attach their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it daily, generating over 100 million euros in ARR across Europe. We're looking for a Senior Backend Developer to help build that.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

Our Knowledge Team is the layer between the content and the AI. We pull in millions of documents from internal databases, public sources, and the web, standardize them, and make them usable for the AI agents that distill answers from them. The real challenge isn't storage but selection. Out of those millions of documents, exactly one paragraph needs to surface the moment a lawyer asks a question. Surface the wrong one, and the agent gives an answer that sounds plausible but is wrong. In our field, that's not a bug: it's a liability issue. What you build determines whether the answer holds up.

There's work to be done, and it's the kind of work you could talk about for a whole evening. The pipeline has been running for six years, built in Scala and Java, and parts of it deserve a new foundation. Reranking is the biggest need: determining which passage, out of a mountain of legal documents, actually answers the question being asked. Not just which one contains the matching words. That's the problem we’re solving. The team is strong on the scientific side, in retrieval, and in understanding what a model can and can't handle.   • Transformatie naar SaaS: Daarnaast transformeer je onze DevOps-omgeving naar een modern SaaS-landschap waarin agent observability, model gateways en agent-aware deploy patterns de standaard zijn.

  • Tech-lead rol: Je bent een echte tech-lead van de executie en communicatie: je stemt soepel af met de andere senior developers en zet complexe uitdagingen om in heldere sprints.

This is not a role where you sit in spreadsheets all day tracking KPIs from a distance. You’ll work directly with international ateliers, suppliers, and technical teams to improve production processes, solve real operational challenges, and help bring premium footwear collections to life.

The collections are produced across multiple international ateliers, meaning you’ll collaborate closely with production partners, technicians, and internal teams to ensure products meet high standards — both technically and aesthetically.

This role offers a combination of operational responsibility and strategic impact. One day you might be improving production flow with an atelier partner, the next you’re involved in onboarding a new supplier or optimizing the launch of a new footwear category.

About Linro

Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Part of this happens on-site: you may spend a few days at a customer's office to get an install running or to work through a problem with their team. Everything you learn goes back to engineering and product. This is an engineering role, not a support or sales role, and there is no quota.

What you will do

title: Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC).


A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics-based modelling, hardware–software co-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements.

As part of our initiative towards fault-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations & Concepts team and are looking for a Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d) to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company.


Role Overview:

As Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d), you will help shaping eleQtron’s long-term roadmap towards logical quantum computing, driving research activities in quantum error correction and fault tolerance, contributing to key architectural decisions, coordinating cross-functional efforts across hardware, software, system architecture and applications, and playing a leading role in building and growing the company’s fault-tolerance capability.


Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and drive fault-tolerant quantum-computing strategies and logical architectures for trapped-ion MAGIC quantum processors.

title: Website Growth & CRO Manager
description:
Berlin, Germany · Full-time

The Role

We are looking for a highly analytical, action-oriented, and entrepreneurial Website Growth & CRO Manager to take ownership of our websites and help turn them into high-performing digital sales channels.

In this role, you will drive improvements across our websites, landing pages, and conversion funnels, combining data-driven experimentation with strong UX/UI intuition, compelling copy, and a deep understanding of customer behavior.

You will take ownership of conversion rates, identify opportunities for growth, and turn insights into tangible improvements. You will also contribute to the development of a new product configurator, helping shape intuitive digital experiences that make it easier for customers to discover, customize, and purchase our products.

We're looking for someone who thinks analytically, moves quickly, and enjoys taking ideas from insight to execution. Early-career candidates with exceptional analytical ability, initiative, and potential are also encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Website Product Ownership: Take ownership of existing websites, landing pages, and conversion funnels, continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance and the customer journey.

title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production.

description:

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As Growth Product Manager at 7NXT Health Group, you drive subscriber growth across all our brands. You find the problems behind our key metrics, test your way to solutions, and make sure what we learn in one brand helps the others. Your focus spans the subscriber lifecycle — with the emphasis on its two ends: acquisition and retention.

You work in close collaboration with Marketing to bring the right people in and find the right offers to keep them: a lot of testing on pricing, offers, landing pages and cancellation flows. This is a mid-level role with real ownership in a fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on attitude, comfortable using AI. You build and launch things yourself — landing pages, tests and prototypes — and use AI to automate your workflows.

title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. E

title: Endear - Product Designer
description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Wij zoeken geen business developer die de semiconductorindustrie wil leren kennen. We zoeken iemand die er al jaren onderdeel van is. Je kent de semiconductorindustrie. Je kent de mensen, de uitdagingen en de technologie. Nu krijg je de ruimte om vanuit die kennis een nieuwe businesspositie voor Itility op te bouwen

 

Wat ga je doen

Je komt om nieuwe deuren te openen. Met jouw netwerk vergroot je de positie van Itility binnen de Europese semiconductor- en photonicamarkt. Je richt je op design houses, OEM's, equipment suppliers, foundries, IDMs, fabless bedrijven, OSAT’s en photonicabedrijven. Je kent de markt, begrijpt hoe organisaties binnen het ecosysteem samenwerken en weet waar nieuwe kansen ontstaan.

 

Je bent veel onderweg. Op beurzen, bij (potentiële) klanten, tijdens consortiumbijeenkomsten en andere plekken waar de industrie samenkomt. Je bouwt gemakkelijk relaties op en bent oprecht geïnteresseerd in wat er speelt. Juist die gesprekken vormen de basis voor nieuwe samenwerkingen. Je hebt fabs en/of Design houses van binnen gezien en voelt je thuis in gesprekken over CVD-reactors, wafer probers, lithografiemachines, chipdesignsoftware, simulatiepakketten en product lifecycle management.

 

Je brengt de juiste mensen aan tafel en vertaalt klantvragen naar concrete projecten. Je werkt samen met ervaren Practice Leads, Managing Consultants, engineers en architecten die de techniek begrijpen. Jij brengt het netwerk en de marktkennis, samen ontwikkelen we nieuwe business.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Wil jij impact maken bij toonaangevende enterprise klanten op het gebied van Cloud technologie?
Als Cloud engineer help je klanten hun digitale transformatie te versnellen door cloudoplossingen te ontwerpen, te realiseren en te optimaliseren. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen strategisch meedenken en operationele uitvoering, en werkt nauw samen met Itility’s Managing Consultants en Cloud engineers. Krijg je hier energie van? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!


Wat jij gaat doen

Je werkt in een projectteam van bevlogen professionals aan het ontwerpen, implementeren en verbeteren van Cloud omgevingen. Samen met je collega-consultants werk je aan innovatieve projecten bij grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan o.a. uit:

  • Het analyseren van klantuitdagingen en vertalen naar praktische cloudoplossingen

  • Het ontwerpen en implementeren van Cloud architecturen (bijvoorbeeld in Azure, AWS of Google Cloud)

  • Het automatiseren van infrastructuur en applicatiebeheer met behulp van IaC-tools en CI/CD-pijplijnen

  • Het verbeteren van bestaande Cloud omgevingen op het gebied van kosten, security, performance en beheerbaarheid

  • Het coachen van klanten en collega’s in het gebruik van Cloud technologie en DevOps-werkwijzen

  • Het bouwen aan een duurzame klantrelatie en het signaleren van nieuwe kansen


Bij Itility krijg je de vrijheid én ondersteuning om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Via onze eigen Itility Academy investeer je continu in je technische expertise en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Daarnaast organiseert onze Cloud Community tech hours waarin we kennis delen, oplossingen en tools demonstreren, en samen specifieke certificaten behalen.

title: Stagiaire MBO/HBO
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een leerzame mbo- of hbo-stage in Zuid-Limburg, waar je écht wordt meegenomen in het werk en wordt gezien als volwaardig collega? Dan ben je bij Nedlin aan het juiste adres.

Wij bieden stageplaatsen voor meewerk- en afstudeerstages (32–40 uur per week), waarin je volop ruimte krijgt om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en praktijkervaring op te doen binnen een professionele én informele werkomgeving.

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de sollicitatieknop. Upload je cv en voeg een motivatiebrief toe waarin je jouw stageopdracht beschrijft, zodat wij kunnen beoordelen of wij een passende stageplek voor je hebben.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.

Voor welke afdelingen en opleidingen?

Techniek / Engineering / Operations
HBO: Technische Bedrijfskunde • Mechanical Engineering
MBO 3: Mechatronica • Technicus Mechatronica • Eerste monteur elektrotechnische installaties in de gebouwde omgeving • Procesoperator B
MBO 4: Operator C • Procesoperator B • Technicus Elektrotechnische Installaties in de Gebouwde Omgeving • Technicus Engineering • Technicus Mechatronica • Technicus Service en Onderhoud Elektrotechniek en Ins

title: Werkstudent Technical Customer Support (12-24u kantoor-uren)
description:
Bij Tameson help je internationale bedrijven met vragen over industriële producten en alles wat daarbij komt kijken. Je zoekt uit welk product past bij een toepassing, vergelijkt specificaties en alternatieven, en pakt ook vragen rond bestellingen en leveringen op.
Je combineert je technisch inzicht met duidelijk klantcontact en een praktische, commerciële blik. Je bouwt snel productkennis op en leert steeds complexere vragen zelfstandig op te lossen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je draait volwaardig mee in ons team en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid. Je:

  • analyseert technische klantvragen en zoekt passende oplossingen;

  • helpt klanten bij productselectie en technische alternatieven;

  • werkt met datasheets, specificaties en productinformatie;

  • lost vragen rond bestellingen, leveringen en retouren zelfstandig op;

  • herkent commerciële kansen en helpt klanten verder richting een aankoop;

  • stelt prioriteiten en zorgt dat klanten snel én goed worden geholpen;

  • signaleert waar onze informatie, processen of service beter kunnen.

Sommige vragen zijn eenvoudig, andere vragen echt technisch uitzoekwerk. Je hoeft onze producten nog niet te kennen, maar je moet het wel leuk vinden om te begrijpen hoe ze werken.


Wie zoeken we?

Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding en bent 12-24 uur per week beschikbaar tijdens kantooruren.

Een technische studie is niet verplicht, maar een duidelijke technische achtergrond wel. Die kan bijvoorbeeld komen uit je studie, werkervaring, projecten of een technische hobby.

Daarnaast:

  • spreek en schrijf je vloeiend Nederlands, zodat je Nederlandse klanten professioneel kunt helpen;

  • begrijp je technische informatie snel en werk je graag met specificaties;

  • denk je analytisch en los je problemen

SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist focused on 3D reconstruction. You will advance methods that recover accurate camera poses and geometry from real-world imagery, working with both classical multi-view geometry and state-of-the-art learned reconstructors. The work includes structure-from-motion, bundle adjustment, SLAM, or feed-forward reconstruction, with a focus on robustness, accuracy, and methods that hold up on diverse real-world data.

Responsibilities

  • Design camera pose estimators and 3D reconstructors.

  • Build robust SfM and camera tracking pipelines for a variety of input imaging sensors.

  • Develop bundle adjusters and nonlinear optimizers, including non-perspective camera formulations.

  • Integrate and extend SOTA feed-forward reconstructors (VGGT, DA3, Pi3)

  • Advance deep multi-view stereo, learned matching, and monocular depth methods for dense geometry.

  • Build evaluation metrics for pose accuracy and reconstruction quality, and drive improvements against public & internal benchmarks.

title: Research Scientist - Robot Learning (VLA / WAM)
description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist to train the policies that turn a world model into a robot that acts. You will own vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, starting, including data, backbone, action representation, training runs, and the evaluation that tells us whether a policy is genuinely competent or merely lucky. A world model that understands geometry and physics still doesn't act on its own; the policy is what closes that gap. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already trained manipulation policies that worked, and who can say precisely why the ones that didn't failed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the training pipeline for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, from data to a policy running on a robot.

  • Contribute to setting the technical direction for embodied research at SpAItial.

  • Close the sim-to-real gap through domain randomization, system identification, and calibration, and build evaluation that predicts real-world transfer.

  • Adapt VLM backbones for control: encoder choice and adapter strategies, co-training.

  • Curate and weight the training mix across heterogeneous robot datasets

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast.

Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier

Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants.

Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast.

  • Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams.

  • Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners.

  • Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Before you read further

HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there.

  • Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it.

  • Full-time in Rotterdam. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening. This is not negotiable.

  • Always on mentality. This is not a 40-hour job; it’s a deliberate choice into something big that requires “what it takes”

  • You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first.

  • You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos.

  • You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE & AI Platform Operations)
description:
HelloPrint is mid-transformation. The entire platform is being rebuilt from the ground up: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine. Everything agent-ready. We ship in a week what used to take a year. What we do not yet have is someone who owns the reliability of all of it: the SLOs, the cost, the AI runtime, and the guardrails that let product engineers move fast without breaking things. That is this role.

Core Objective: Take full technical ownership of production reliability, distributed observability, deployment safety, cost optimization, and AI runtime infrastructure across high-velocity microservices and cloud workloads.


What you will do:

  • SLOs & Error Budgets: Define, track, and enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error-budget policies across core customer journeys and critical services (including checkout, payments, catalog pipelines, and routing engines).

  • Distributed Observability & Telemetry: Expand Telemetry, Sentry + Google Cloud Monitoring distributed tracing, and automated diagnostic tooling across microservices, Laravel Horizon queue workers on Redis, and Google Cloud infrastructure.

  • Deployment Safety & Progressive Delivery: Partner with product teams to evolve CI/CD pipelines with canary traffic shifting, automated SLO-driven rollbacks, and automated health gates in GitHub Actions.

  • AI Platform Operations & FinOps

Are you levelheaded and can you keep an good overview? Do you want a responsible job where you won't get bored for a moment? Then step into the world of rail freight.

description:
Wir sind Sustainable Med, eine junge Privatpraxis für orthopädische Behandlung, Diagnostik und Prävention in Berlin. Unser Arzt Jan betreut Patient:innen mit Schmerzen am Bewegungsapparat genauso wie Bundesliga-Profis. Wir begleiten Menschen über Monate, messen Fortschritte und bleiben dran, bis das Ziel erreicht ist.

Wir stehen ganz am Anfang. Die Praxis wächst gerade auf zwei Standorte, das Team wird größer, und unsere Marke entsteht in diesen Monaten. Auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube gibt es bisher kaum etwas von uns. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du bist die erste Person im Team, die sich voll auf Content und Growth konzentriert und unsere Kanäle von 0 auf 1 bringt.

  • Du baust von 0 auf 1. Redaktionsplan, Formate, Look und Tonalität entstehen mit dir. Was du in den ersten Monaten aufbaust, wird das Fundament unserer Marke.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
description:
Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies (including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN) use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Every one of those products depends on fresh, reliable creator data. Data Core owns the systems that collect and maintain profiles for 400M+ creators across social platforms, process billions of data points, and keep the rest of Modash supplied with the raw material it needs.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system, from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving, and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfull

title: Intelligence Center X Principal - EMEA
description:

Principals bring deep industry knowledge, full-stack command of ICX and the wider Siemens portfolio, and senior relationships across R&D and Siemens leadership that enable them to unblock challenges beyond the reach of an individual deal team.

The role combines deep technical expertise, industry perspective and senior stakeholder engagement to help shape the most strategic ICX opportunities and establish approaches that can be applied more broadly across the practice.

Technical

  • Ontology and knowledge-graph design: A plus, but not required. Where present, experience should extend to production-scale implementations.

    • Competitive positioning: Able to position ICX against Databricks, Snowflake and Palantir in front of a customer in a live deal.
    • Use-case identification and value engineering: Finds where the value is in an account, builds the business case with the customer, and establishes value patterns that the zones can reuse.
    • Executive presence and internal reach: Brings gravitas with senior stakeholders and can navigate and mobilize a large organization to unblock a deal.
    • Industry depth: A plus rather than a requirement for every hire. Across the ten Principals, we want meaningful depth across our core industries: automotive, aerospace, industrial machinery, electronics and pharma

Waniwani builds the infrastructure that distributes insurance and banking products through AI assistants. We raised an $8M seed led by Seedcamp and work with large European banks and insurers. title: Stage of Afstuderen: Decision Support System
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen onze organisatie maken we gebruik van een configurator om klant-specifieke productielijnen samen te stellen. Dit proces vraagt om kennis van zowel de klantbehoefte als de technische mogelijkheden van onze systemen. Momenteel wordt deze kennis handmatig verzameld – een tijdrovend en foutgevoelig proces. Jij gaat onderzoeken hoe we dit slimmer en efficiënter kunnen maken met behulp van een decision support systeem.

Tijdens deze opdracht onderzoek je welke voorkennis nodig is om een productielijn correct te configureren en hoe deze kennis gestructureerd en vastgelegd kan worden in een decision support systeem. Op basis van je bevindingen stel je een requirements document op waarin de functionele en niet-functionele eisen voor een nieuwe configurator staan beschreven.

De focus van je opdracht verschilt per type traject:

  • Tijdens een meewerkstage ligt de nadruk op het praktisch in kaart brengen en modelleren van informatie. Je werkt aan het ontwerp van een conceptuele “pre-configurator” en vertaalt inzichten direct naar visuele of functionele voorstellen.

  • Tijdens een afstudeeropdracht ligt de nadruk meer op onderzoek en onderbouwing. Je analyseert de informatiebehoefte, onderzoekt methoden voor kennismodellering en valideert jouw concept op bruikbaarheid en effectiviteit.

Je werkzaamheden kunnen onder andere bestaan uit:

title: Stage Elektrotechniek: Decentrale drives
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Voortman Steel Machinery ga je aan de slag met een technische onderzoeksopdracht voor de FAB iX, onze automatische lasrobot. De kern van deze opdracht is het onderzoeken of het technisch, praktisch en economisch haalbaar is om de huidige centrale drives in de machine te vervangen door decentrale drives, inclusief een onderbouwde vergelijking tussen beide oplossingen.

Op dit moment bevindt een groot aantal drives zich gecentraliseerd in de MCC (besturingskast) van de FAB iX. Om vloerruimte te besparen en machines meer modulematig te kunnen bouwen en testen, is de wens om deze drives te verplaatsen naar het veld, in de vorm van decentrale drives. Dit vraagt om inzicht in de technische consequenties, kosten en toepasbaarheid binnen de bestaande machinearchitectuur.

Tijdens deze stageopdracht voer je een haalbaarheidsstudie uit waarbij je onderzoekt of een decentrale aandrijfarchitectuur binnen de FAB iX realiseerbaar is. Daarbij kijk je onder andere naar:

  • Geschikte decentrale drive‑series met verschillende beschermingsklassen (IP65 / IP66 / IP67);

  • De integratie met het bestaande besturingssysteem (PLC en fieldbus);

  • Vermogenseisen en beschikbare varianten;

  • Montageopties, zoals montage op de motor of wandmontage;

  • Beschikbare veiligheidsfuncties, waaronder STO, SLS en vergelijkbare functies.

Je vertaalt deze analyse naar een technische haalbaarheidsstudie en maakt een kostenvergelijking tussen centrale en decentrale drives. De resultaten werk je uit in een eindverslag waarin je je conclusies onderbouwt en duidelijke aanbevelingen formuleert voor eventuele vervolgstappen.

title: Software Engineer C# Machines
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Engineer C# Machines werk je binnen een van onze machineteams aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe bewerkingsmachines. Je ontwikkelt software voor de logische laag van onze machines: de intelligentie die bepaalt wat een machine doet, hoe processen verlopen en hoe verschillende functies samenwerken. Daarbij los je dagelijks technisch uitdagende vraagstukken op. Hoe zorg je ervoor dat meerdere bewerkingen optimaal op elkaar aansluiten? Hoe automatiseer je complexe processen zodat de machine efficiënter, slimmer en gebruiksvriendelijker wordt? Dit zijn de vraagstukken waar jij je mee bezighoudt.

Het bijzondere aan deze rol is dat je niet alleen software ontwikkelt, maar ook ziet wat jouw werk in de praktijk doet. Je vertaalt ideeën en concepten naar werkende functionaliteiten die uiteindelijk zichtbaar worden in een fysieke machine. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het ontwikkelen van slimme software die bepaalt in welke volgorde staalbewerkingen worden uitgevoerd door een of meerdere machines voor maximale productiviteit. Software speelt daarbij een belangrijke rol binnen Voortman. Het is één van de strategische pijlers van onze organisatie en een belangrijk onderdeel van hoe onze machines zich onderscheiden in de markt.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines, zoals PLC Software Engineers, Software Test Engineers, Mechanical Engineers en Electrical Engineers. Daarbij is het belangrijk om de scheiding tussen de softwarelagen helder te houden. Als C# Software Engineer richt jij je op de logische besturing en functionaliteit van de machine. De directe aansturing van hardware, motoren en I/O verloopt via PLC-software, ontwikkeld door onze PLC Software Engineers. Tegelijkertijd werk je regelmatig samen op het snijvlak van beide vakgebieden om machines optimaal te laten functioneren. Omdat de ontwikkeling van een nieuwe machine gemiddeld twee jaar duurt, werk je langdurig aan uitdagende technische vraagstuk

title: Supply Chain Engineer
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Supply Chain Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in het optimaliseren van de materiaalbeschikbaarheid binnen onze organisatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat materialen tijdig beschikbaar zijn voor productie, interne klanten en intercompany locaties. Daarbij werk je op het snijvlak van supply chain, productieplanning en inkoop. Met behulp van data-analyses en MRP-gegevens signaleer je risico’s, afwijkingen en verbeterkansen en onderneem je actie om de continuïteit van de supply chain te waarborgen.

Je vertaalt klantvraag en forecastinformatie naar een haalbare materiaalplanning en bewaakt daarbij de balans tussen beschikbaarheid, voorraadniveaus en leverbetrouwbaarheid. In deze functie combineer je operationele werkzaamheden met een sterk verbetergerichte blik. Je onderzoekt processen, analyseert prestaties en neemt initiatieven om materiaalstromen en planningsprocessen verder te optimaliseren.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het controleren van MRP-runs en analyseren van exceptionlijsten om materiaalbehoeften en risico’s inzichtelijk te maken;

  • Het verzamelen, analyseren en rapporteren van supply chain KPI’s;

  • Het beheren en verbeteren van masterdata zoals lead times, stuklijsten en planningsparameters;

  • Het vertalen van klantvraag, forecastgegevens en productiebehoeften naar een haalbare materiaalplanning;

  • Het bewaken van materiaalbeschikbaarheid voor productie, intercompany locaties en interne stakeholders;

  • Het afstemmen met inkoop over leveringen en leveranciersprestaties;

  • Het samenwerken met productieplanning over capaciteit, prioriteiten en de optimale volgorde van werkzaamheden;

  • Het initiëren en realiseren van verbeteringen binnen materiaalstromen, voorraadbeheer en MRP-processen.

title: Strategic Product Manager Service
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Strategic Product Manager Service ontwikkel en positioneer je het servicedomein Improve & Advise. Je bouwt aan een portfolio van datagedreven serviceproposities, advies- en productiviteitsdiensten waarmee klanten hun productieproces beter begrijpen, gerichter verbeteren en toekomstige prestaties betrouwbaarder voorspellen. title: Afstuderen Software: Automatisch inmeten
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Voordat een plaat bewerkt kan worden, moet een machine exact weten waar deze zich bevindt. Op dit moment gebeurt een groot deel van dit inmeetproces nog handmatig. Dat kost tijd en vraagt aandacht van de operator terwijl die zich liever richt op het productieproces. Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht ontwikkel jij een oplossing waarmee het inmeten van platen verder geautomatiseerd wordt, zodat de machine zelfstandig en betrouwbaar de exacte positie van een plaat kan bepalen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van de opdracht is de interactie tussen operator en machine. Jij onderzoekt en ontwikkelt een gebruiksvriendelijke oplossing waarmee een operator tijdens het productieproces kan aangeven waar een plaat zich ongeveer bevindt, zonder de machine hiervoor te hoeven bewegen. Zodra de plaat aan de beurt is voor bewerking, start de machine automatisch jouw ontwikkelde inmeetroutine. Hierdoor hoeft de operator niet meer aanwezig te zijn tijdens het meten en ontstaat meer ruimte voor voorbereiding en onbemande productie.

Je komt terecht binnen het multidisciplinaire Plates-team van Voortman in Rijssen. Hier werk je samen met softwareontwikkelaars en engineers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor plaatbewerkingsmachines. Binnen deze omgeving krijg je de vrijheid om onderzoek te doen, concepten uit te werken, software te ontwikkelen en jouw oplossing direct in een praktijkomgeving te testen. Je werkt daarbij op het eigen softwareplatform VACAM en doet ervaring op met industriële automatisering, machinebesturing en softwareontwikkeling.


Wij vragen

  • HBO- of WO-student Software Engineering, Computer Science of vergelijkbare technische opleiding;

  • interesse in softwareontwikkeling, machinebesturing en industriële automatisering;

  • analytisch sterk en in staat om complexe technische

title: Stage PLC Software: Ontwikkeling Labelmachine
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen deze stageopdracht ga je aan de slag met het werkend krijgen van een automatische labelmachine voor stalen profielen. Je werkt aan een fysieke prototype-opstelling waarin je jouw software direct kunt testen en valideren. Een bestaande labelmachine wordt gekoppeld aan een lineaire as met servomotor, waarmee de labelmachine nauwkeurig boven een conveyor kan bewegen. Over deze conveyor worden stalen profielen getransporteerd die automatisch van een label moeten worden voorzien.

Jij ontwikkelt de aansturing van dit systeem. Met behulp van sensoren bepaal je de positie van bewegende profielen en zorg je ervoor dat de labelmachine op het juiste moment de juiste positie bereikt. De besturing wordt gerealiseerd in een Beckhoff PLC met TwinCAT. Daarnaast zet je de communicatie tussen de PLC en de labelmachine op en zorg je ervoor dat alle componenten betrouwbaar samenwerken.

Je bent betrokken bij het volledige proces: van het uitlezen van sensoren, het programmeren van de besturing tot het testen, optimaliseren en inbedrijfstellen van de oplossing. Hierdoor doe je praktijkervaring op met industriële automatisering, PLC-programmering, motion control, sensortechniek en machine-integratie. Je werkt zelfstandig aan een oplossing die direct toepasbaar is binnen de machinebouw.


Wij vragen

  • Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Mechatronica, Electrotechniek, Industriële Automatisering of vergelijkbaar;

  • Proactieve werkhouding en een praktische instelling;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse of Engelse taal.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

This is a new, hands-on role sitting directly within Engineering. At least 30% of your time will be spent actively looking for vulnerabilities in our own products. Your goal won't simply be to find and fix individual vulnerabilities. You'll help us understand their root causes and eliminate whole classes of security issues across our products.

You'll work alongside our engineering leads and closely with our existing Security and GRC team. They own corporate security policy, certification, risk and incident response; you'll focus on product security, close to our engineers, architecture and code.

This isn't a gatekeeper role. Your impact will come from partnering with teams, building trust, and creating solutions that make the secure way the easiest way to build.

As our first dedicated Principal Product Security Engineer, you'll also have significant influence over how the function develops. We'll bring the context and priorities; you'll help turn them into a product security roadmap and own the technical direction from there.

title: Senior Partnership Marketeer
description:
Senior Partnership Marketeer

De missie

Iedereen verdient een eerlijke kans om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Toch wordt in veel organisaties nog beoordeeld op onderbuikgevoel.

Daar gaan wij verandering in brengen. Learned maakt evalueren, ontwikkelen en belonen eerlijk, transparant en uitlegbaar. Zo hebben leidinggevenden meer tijd voor de gesprekken die er echt toe doen.

Meer dan 350 organisaties werken al met Learned. Met loontransparantie in aantocht staat eerlijk belonen hoger op de agenda dan ooit. Ons doel: een eerlijkere arbeidsmarkt in Nederland. Bouw je mee?

De kans

Steeds meer van onze groei komt via partners: HR-adviesbureaus en HR-softwarepartijen die Learned bij hun klanten introduceren. Hoe meer partners ons verhaal vertellen, hoe sneller we die eerlijkere arbeidsmarkt bereiken.

Partnerships is bij ons een nieuw kanaal. De eerste partners zijn aangesloten en de eerste successen zijn er. Maar hoe we samen marketing doen, staat nog grotendeels open.

En dat is precies de kans. Jij bepaalt hoe partnership marketing bij Learned eruitziet. Je hebt geen draaiboek om te volgen, want jij schrijft het.

Je ziet bij elke nieuwe partner meteen waarom we samen sterker zijn, en voor wie. Je giet dat in een plan, enthousiasmeert de partner en zorgt dat het van kick-off tot resultaat loopt. Het ene moment denk je strategisch, het volgende regel je zelf de eventlocatie.

Wat je gaat doen:

description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Insurance Platform team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would take technical leadership in that team, and shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch.

title: Werkstudent:in Landwirtschaft und betriebliche Datenprüfung (all genders) (Berlin I DE Remote möglich)
description:
Please note: This job description is written in German as the role requires fluency in German and active collaboration with German-speaking stakeholders. We want to ensure clarity around expectations and language needs from the start.

Startdatum: ab 07.09.2026 - Befristet bis 28.02.2027

Bei Klim arbeiten wir mit Landwirten und Lebensmittelunternehmen zusammen, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und für Landwirte finanziell attraktiv zu gestalten. Über unsere Plattform unterstützen wir Landwirte dabei, die Bodengesundheit wiederherzustellen, die Artenvielfalt zu fördern und CO₂ zu binden – und gleichzeitig neue, verlässliche Einnahmequellen zu erschließen.

Als Berliner AgriTech-Startup – unterstützt durch eine Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar – arbeiten wir mit führenden globalen Lebensmittelunternehmen wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen. Gemeinsam reduzieren wir Emissionen in deren Lieferketten und stärken die langfristige Resilienz. Seit 2020 haben wir bereits 3.500 Landwirte unterstützt, die zusammen mehr als 900.000 Hektar bewirtschaften.

Wenn du dich für ein nachhaltiges Ernährungssystem und echten Klimaschutz begeisterst, komm zu uns und hilf mit, einen gesünderen Planeten zu schaffen!

Deine Mission

Klim begleitet Landwirt:innen und Unternehmen bei der Umstellung auf regenerative Landwirtschaft. Klim hat eine digitale Plattform entwickelt, die den Betrieben eine einfache Möglichkeit bietet, ihre regenerativen Maßnahmen zu dokumentieren, Finanzierungen für ihre umgesetzten Maßnahmen zu erhalten und vom Fachwissen einer engagierten Community zu profitieren. Gemeinsam mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben und teilnehmenden

title: Senior Tax Manager (gn)
description:
Your mission

The Bikeleasing Group continues to grow and is expanding its international tax function. As a Senior Tax Manager (gn), your initial focus will be on our tax matters in Germany. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to develop international topics and structures together with the relevant stakeholders. Close collaboration with external tax advisory firms, specialist departments, authorities and our parent company will be part of your daily work. The position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Germany and includes occasional business travel. Sounds good? Then we look forward to getting to know you.
Your tasks

  • You will manage the Bikeleasing Group’s tax matters independently, initially with a focus on Germany and increasingly on international topics in the future
  • You will prepare tax returns, tax declarations, input tax refund claims and withholding tax applications carefully and on time
  • You will be responsible for tax calculations in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) as well as the IFRS reporting package for our parent company
  • You will continuously monitor, document and optimise intra-group transfer pricing
  • You will actively contribute your expertise to VAT-related matters and tax audits
  • As the central point of contact for specialist departments, external tax advisory firms and authorities, you will provide clarity on complex tax matters
  • You will further develop international tax topics and tax processes together with the relevant stakeholders


Your profile

  • A completed degree in business administration, economics or law with a focus on taxation, or a comparable qualification
  • At least five years of professional experience in the tax department of a company or at an auditing or tax advisory firm
  • In-depth knowledge of German tax law and, ideally, international tax law

Unser AI-Team besteht nun seit 4 Monaten, aktuell ein Developer, eine Produktmanagerin und unsere Head of AI.
