This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Due to continued growth, internal promotions and an ongoing need to support our expanding customer base, we’re excited to be hiring Customer Service Advisors.

Operations in banking like in every other firm is established to carry out all the day-to-day transactions of the business. The Operations function within Allica has wide-ranging responsibilities supporting the customers of all product lines (Commercial Mortgages, Asset Finance, Deposits and Payment Account with aligned card activity), alongside our own internal stakeholders.

Introduction

At Impower GmbH, we are developing the future of property management – simple, fast, and digital. With a strong team of now around 90 employees and over 10,000 users, we are changing an industry whose processes are often still manual, complex, and time-consuming. In this role, you are a key sparring partner for the management team and an absolute doer.   • Professionalization of the accounting process: As we grow, our requirements increase. You analyze the status quo, optimize our accounting processes, and elevate our workflows to a highly professional, scalable level, leveraging state of the art technology.

At 5Plus (part of Pentadoc Group), we build production-grade AI systems that solve real operational problems for our customers.

As a AI Engineer (m/f/d), you will take technical responsibility for customer-facing AI solutions — from early design decisions to production deployment and operation. You will design, build, and operate AI applications ranging from LLM-powered workflows (e.g., intelligent document processing, RAG systems) to agentic AI systems that are actively used in customer environments.

German language skills at C1 level and above are mandatory for this role.

You’ll work closely with customers and internal engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into reliable, scalable systems and guide AI-driven product development within customer projects. This role is hybrid, with predominantly remote work and occasional on-site presence at customer locations across Germany and our office in Würzburg, Bavaria.

Your profile

  • Several years (3–6) of hands-on experience building and operating AI/ML systems in real-world projects.
  • Solid experience implementing agents on the LangChain stack (LangGraph, DeepAgents) in Python, including FastAPI interfaces.
  • Experience with AWS (e.g. ECS, CDK, …)
  • Strong Python expertise (app. 5 years) and experience with modern AI/LLM tooling; framework-agnostic mindset.
  • Proven experience with LLM-based systems (e.g., RAG, embeddings, tool usage) and an understanding of trade-offs between quality, cost, latency, and complexity.<

title: Einsatzentwickler Künstliche Intelligenz (FDE) (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern dort einsetzen, wo sie wirklich etwas verändert?

Dann entwickle mit uns KI-Lösungen für den Mittelstand. Als Einsatzentwickler konzentrierst du dich voll auf die Entwicklung von KI-Systemen und deren direkte Umsetzung beim Kunden. Du verstehst Prozesse, integrierst Sprachmodelle und baust intelligente Anwendungen, die im Arbeitsalltag funktionieren.

Über uns

Agentur Philipp ist auf die praktische Umsetzung von Künstlicher Intelligenz spezialisiert. Mit einem Team aus über 20 Menschen begleiten wir Unternehmen im KI-Marathon® durch Beratung, Entwicklung und Optimierung. Wir entwickeln KI-Kollegen, automatisieren Prozesse und verbinden bestehende Systeme. Unser Ziel: keine isolierten Prototypen, sondern Lösungen, die Mitarbeiter spürbar entlasten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete KI-Architekturen.

  • Du entwickelst KI-Agenten, LLM-Integrationen, Automatisierungen und intelligente Anwendungen.

  • Du integrierst Sprachmodelle und KI-Funktionen über APIs in bestehende ERP-, CRM- und weitere Unternehmenssysteme.

  • Du arbeitest bei gezielten Einsätzen direkt beim Kunden vor Ort und setzt KI-Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Fachabteilungen um.

  • Du begleitest deine KI-Modelle und -Anwendungen vom ersten Prototyp bis zum produktiven Einsatz, inklusive Tests, Dokumentation und Optimierung.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Beratung und Projektleitung zusammen und machst aus Projekterfahrungen wiederverwendbare KI-Komponenten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der KI-Entwicklung und im Softwarebau, beispielsweise mit Python oder TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit APIs, Vektordatenbanken, Prompt Engineering und der Anbindung von Sprachmodellen.

  • Fundierte umgesetzte Projekte mit Sprachmodellen

Du suchst keine 08/15-Küche, sondern willst als Kulinarische:r Leiter:in bei Lilo Kitchen dein eigenes Ding machen und unsere Vision von „Pretty Good Food“ auf den Teller bringen?

Dann suchen wir genau dich! Wir bei der Pretty Good Food GmbH kreieren Erlebnisse, die bleiben – und mit Lilo Kitchen setzen wir ein neues Highlight für alle, die Wert auf Qualität, Nachhaltigkeit und Geschmack legen.

Aufgaben

  • Küchen-Chef & Visionär: Du übernimmst die volle kulinarische Verantwortung für unser Tagesbistro Lilo Kitchen.
  • Konzeption: Du entwickelst unsere Speisekarte weiter – von saisonalen Tagesgerichten bis hin zu durchdachten Food-Konzepten, die unsere Gäste begeistern.

  • Organisation: Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit, die Kalkulation und die HACCP-Standards souverän im Blick.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist ausgebildete:r Koch / Köchin und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in leitender Position in einem Bistro, Café oder in der gehobenen Systemgastronomie gesammelt.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für moderne, zeitgemäße Food-Trends und liebst es, kreativ zu experimentieren.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und behältst auch bei vollem Haus den Überblick und ein Lächeln auf den Lippen.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

title: Research Engineer - Eval Platform
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Evaluation is how we decide which models, checkpoints and recipes ship. As a Research Engineer on the Eval Platform team, you will build the infrastructure every science team relies on to measure model quality, and make it reliable, reproducible and fast.

You don't need to have designed benchmarks before. You do need to care about what a score means, and about when a difference between two runs is real.

What you will do

  • Build systems that keep eval results reproducible and comparable over time, as models, benchmarks and code evolve.

  • Run evaluations at scale across our GPU clusters, from model serving to scoring.

  • Make eval results easy to access, explore and trust, through APIs and dashboards that researchers use every day.

  • Catch broken or noisy evals before they mislead research decisions.

  • Support evaluation of agentic, multi-turn and tool-using models.<

description:
About the Job

Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care, and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating bold solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand.

This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a dynamic, ambitious team Medical Affairs. You will play a critical part in driving innovation and making an impact in the clinical research space, while enjoying a stimulating professional environment that encourages personal and intellectual growth.

The Medical Data Officer works in close collaboration with the Study Medical

Reviewer and participates in managing/reviewing the medical consistency of

reported clinical data to ensure that medical data in database are accurate, reliable

and analyzable.

Main Responsibilities

  1. Study Setup Tasks


* Protocol Review especially topics linked to safety management, specific data that could need to be coded, inclusion, selection criteria, study design, pathology and mechanism of action of the IMP


* Database specification review and User acceptance test on eCRF, and Database validation tools used for medical review


* Participate in identification of Important Protocol Deviation detection method and their implementation (specifications, and UAT)

  1. Study Conduct Tasks

 
* Medical Coding of Adverse Events, medical and surgical history, other specific events and all treatments, including treatment indication.

* Medical Review might check the medical data entered by the investigator using available tools and processes and can create manual queries for clarification, confirmation, or correction if needed.

title: Structural Dynamics Engineer
description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking an Aeroelastic/Structural Dynamics Engineer to lead structural dynamic and aeroelastic simulation activities across our vehicle programmes, from model setup through test correlation.

The ideal candidate bridges analysis and test – ensuring dynamic behaviour is accurately predicted, verified, and substantiated against experimental data.

What You’ll Do

· Set up, execute, and post-process structural dynamics and aeroelastic simulations

· Create and maintain Global Finite Element Models (GFEM) representing vehicle-level dynamic behaviour, ensuring consistency and traceability with detailed local FE models

· Support structural dynamic qualification and verification of components, subsystems, and full vehicle assemblies

· Define, document, and oversee execution of vibration, modal survey, and ground vibration test (GVT) campaigns

· Correlate simulation predictions against experimental test data; interpret and communicate results clearly

· Prepare technical reports, analysis documentation, and design justification packages

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in structural dynamics, aeroelasticity, or vibration engineering

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct – for modal, transient, frequency response, and/or random vibration analysis

· Demonstrated experience defining and executing vibration and dynamic test plans

· Strong ability to correlate experimental test data against simulation predictions

· Solid grounding in structural dynamics fundamentals: SDOF/MDOF systems, modal analysis, damping, and forced response

title: Stress Engineer - Non-linear & Propellants
description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures.

A core part of this role is the structural simulation of propellant grains, liner bonds, thermal protection systems (TPS), and propellant–liner–casing interfaces – combining FEA with material characterization and test correlation to build substantiated models of energetic material assemblies.

What You’ll Do

· Conduct stress analysis using both classical hand-calculation methods and FEA – linear and non-linear, static and dynamic

· Simulate solid rocket motor structures: propellant grain stress and strain fields, bond integrity at propellant–liner and liner–casing interfaces, TPS thermomechanical response, and igniter/nozzle attachment loads

· Conduct non-linear simulations covering geometric non-linearity, material non-linearity (plasticity, hyperelasticity for propellant and elastomeric materials), and contact mechanics

· Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads

· Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables

· Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly

· Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in stress analysis of aerospace or mechanical structures

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct/HyperWorks for bot

title: Associate GTM Recruiter
description:
About You

We're looking for an Associate GTM Recruiter who is competitive, curious, and hungry to become exceptional at recruiting. At Constructor, we hire builders: people who take real ownership of their work, spot what needs fixing, and fix it without waiting to be asked. You'll bring that same mindset to how we hire.

Most of your time will go to sourcing and outreach: finding great people for our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams and getting them excited to talk to us. You'll also own a smaller funnel of candidates from start to finish, including sourcing, screening, scheduling, and closing offers. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their recruiting career (or coming from an SDR/BDR seat) who wants real exposure, real responsibility, and a path to growing into a full-cycle recruiter.


About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE 

At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
description:
The Opportunity

Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin.

The Role

You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails.

What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules.

By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release.

What You'll Do

  • Run pre-layout channel studies to set routing topologies, stackups, materials and design constraints for high-speed interfaces.

  • Carry out post-layout SI analysis

title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Analog Design
description:
The Opportunity

At the centre of an optical computer sits a set of circuits that have to read, drive and hold steady some very small, very fast signals: photodetector front ends, laser and modulator drives, precision converter interfaces, and the quiet power and references underneath them. This role owns them, at board level, from the optical requirement through to the production build.

The Role

You will design the board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits that connect our electronics to light, and take them the whole way: specification, simulation, layout guidance, lab bring-up, characterisation and production. You will agree the optical requirements - optical power budgets, bandwidth, noise, linearity - with the photonics and system teams, and turn them into analog architectures and circuit specifications.

What is genuinely hard about it is working at the boundary between optics, mixed-signal and high-speed digital, where noise budgets are tight and the measurement is as demanding as the design. A microvolt-level front end does not care that the same board carries high-current switching rails; getting both right on one stackup is the job.

By month six, you will have characterised at least one full analog subsystem on the bench, correlated it with simulation across corners, and put the layout constraints and test procedures in place that other engineers can follow.

What You'll Do

  • Design board-level analog and mixed-signal circuits: photodiode front ends, TIAs, ADC/DAC driver and reconstruction stages, laser drivers, modulator drivers and bias networks.

  • Translate photonic system requirements into analog sp

  • Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks — sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction — reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes.

  • Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking.

  • Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable.

  • Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers.

Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

You'd be one of the first QA hires in the UK, working alongside our UK QA Lead to build how we do quality here: frameworks, standards and process, with no legacy test debt to dig out of. Everybody here is hands-on, and that's what this role is: in the detail, every day.

Before anything we build reaches a pharmacist's queue in the US, someone has to decide it's ready. That's you. If you take pride in what ships, and you'll say "this isn't ready" even when everyone wants it out the door, you'll fit right in.

We've built an AI operating system for pharmacies, tackling the operational infrastructure behind things like paperwork and care coordination. It's in production with enterprise health systems

title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

title: Mid-Market Onboarding Lead
description: 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲  At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.      𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁:  As Mid-Market Onboarding Lead for North America, you'll own the onboarding experience for our most important growth market: independent hotels, resorts, and multi-property groups moving to Cloudbeds, often from enterprise systems like Opera. You'll lead the regional team of Onboarding Project Managers and Mid-Market Coaches who take these customers from signed contract through kickoff, go-live, Hypercare, and a clean handoff to Account Management.  This is a player-coach role. You'll build and run the team, and you'll also stay close to the work, personally overseeing a small set of our most strategic North American accounts and stepping in when a project is at risk. Our mid-market customers expect a partner who understands their operation, not just our software. You'll set that standard: consultative kickoffs, clear expectations, and guidance on how their workflows and SOPs should change, not only which buttons to click.  You'll report to the Global Director of Mid-Market Onboarding and work alongside regional leads in LATAM, EMEA, and APAC. You'll be measured on time-to-live, deployment quality, onboarding CSAT, early-lifecycle retention, and the strength and readiness of your team.     𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗠𝗶𝗱-𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗲𝘁 𝗢𝗻𝗯𝗼𝗮𝗿𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:  Our Mid-Market Onboarding team is a global group of former hoteliers, project managers, and implementation specialists. We're purpose-built for complex customers: coaches carry fewer accounts so they can go deeper, every project has structure, and the first days after go-live are covered by a dedicated Hypercare phase. We test and learn constantly, use AI and automation to strip out admin work, and save our time for what matters most: building trust and helping hoteliers run a better operation from day one. Our principle: standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful.     𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:   Lead, coach, and develop the North America team of Onboarding Project Managers and Mid-Market Coaches, including team members based in Latin America who serve North American customers, with clear expectations, regular 1:1s, performance management, and growth paths  Raise the bar on customer

title: Customer Success Consultant / Dutch-speaking / €40K-54K
description: About the company   Our client is a fast-growing Dutch PropTech scale-up that connects property owners, property managers and tenants in one platform. Communication, maintenance, tickets, documents, procurement and compliance for a building all sit in one place. Their clients include well-known real estate names and investors. This has been their best year yet: one of the largest independent property managers in the Netherlands chose them as its compliance and maintenance hub for its whole residential portfolio.      The role   You make sure clients actually get value from the software. You are the first face for property managers who have just joined and need to get their first building documents, certificates and processes into the platform. Instead of losing time to loose emails and missing files, they have overview and control from day one.     There are no sales targets and no revenue responsibility. Your impact shows in clients who can work on their own after your training. You work closely with the Customer Success Lead, and with product and sales, so what clients need ends up in the platform.      What you will do    Onboard new clients, especially their building documents and certificates  Run training and support sessions so users get more out of the platform  Help create recorded webinars as an easy-to-use knowledge source  Spot patterns in what clients find difficult, and fix them yourself  Build lasting relationships with key clients and partners  Develop and carry out customer success strategies  Flag new opportunities and product ideas that help the company grow  In your first year, learn the real estate industry and the platform in depth       Who you are    Service-minded, people-focused and positive, even under pressure  Good at making complex features simple to understand  Empathetic, with strong problem-solving skills, and you keep asking until the problem is really solved  Comfortable juggling several questions and tasks at once  You speak up for the client inside the company  A bachelor's degree or equivalent, with a background in hospitality, customer success or another service role  Fluent in Dutch and English, spoken and written       What you get    €3,500 to €4,500 gross per month, excluding 8% holiday pay  3% pension  25 days of leave a year  Hybrid work from Hoofddorp, with a laptop and an e-SIM so you keep your own phone  Training and professional development  Growth to Customer Success Manager and senior roles  A young, ambitious, international team where there is room for initiative

title: Customer Operations Manager (German speaking, Remote)
description: Join Nezasa as a Customer Operations Manager   Do you get energy from making customers successful, and from working across people, technology and business goals to get there? We're looking for an experienced Customer Operations Manager with a solid technical project management background to own customer relationships in the German speaking market.      About Nezasa   Nezasa's solutions help Tour Operators and Airlines boost sales, optimise operations, reduce costs and create memorable experiences. We're a travel tech innovator shaping the future of travel.      The Role   Your north star is simple: provide the best Customer Operations experience to every customer you own. In practice, that means talking to many different stakeholders about very different topics on any given day:   Showing a customer a new feature and how it fits their business  Collecting customer feedback on bugs or functionality and taking it to our Product and Engineering teams, then closing the loop with the customer  Setting up the onboarding plan for a new customer and guiding them to go live as fast as possible  Aligning with a technical partner or supplier, or with the customer's IT team, on an integration      A good part of our operations is technical. You will regularly run projects with integrations and dependencies across our Product and Engineering teams, our technical partners and our customers' technical teams. That's why technical project management skills matter a lot in this role.     You own a portfolio of customers, from standard setups to complex, multi stakeholder accounts. You stay their single point of contact for everything operational, from contract signature through onboarding, go live and steady state.     We are an AI first company. Every person and team at Nezasa is expected to use AI in their daily work and to help rethink how work gets done. You'll work with tools such as Claude, Gemini and Intercom (Fin), and you'll help shape how AI changes customer operations.       Location:  Remote (Europe). Offices in Lisbon and Zurich are available if you'd like to use them.   Language : Fluent German and English required.       You will…    Own a portfolio of customers, mainly in the German-speaking market, from contract signature to steady state  Plan and run customer onboarding projects end to end: define scope, milestones, dependencies and risks, and get customers to go live in the shortest possible time  Coordinate multi-phase rollouts across internal teams, technical partners, suppliers and customer side teams  Keep timelines, blockers, and decisions visible to all stakeholders, and escalate early when a project is at risk  Lead configuration workshops and manage product setups, including integrations with suppliers and third-party systems  Join technical conversations with customers, partners, and Engineering: understand the problem, translate between business and technical language, and keep everyone aligned while Engineering owns the solution

title: ERP Manager Microsoft Dynamics NAV/ Business Central (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns die nächste Generation unserer ERP-Landschaft.    HeilpflanzenWohl entwickelt und vertreibt OTC-Arzneimittel und Nahrungsergänzungsmittel und ist Teil der international aufgestellten HPW-Gruppe. Von unserem Standort in Berlin aus treiben wir das Wachstum unserer Marken und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Systeme voran.   Ein zentraler Baustein dabei ist unsere ERP-Landschaft: Aktuell arbeiten wir mit Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2017 – für 2027 ist die Migration auf Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central geplant.   Dafür suchen wir nicht einfach jemanden, der unser ERP verwaltet. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Prozesse versteht und gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen und externen Partnern unsere zukünftige ERP-Landschaft gestaltet.    Aufgaben     Deine Rolle    Als ERP Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die zentrale Verantwortung für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unseres ERP-Systems sowie für die geplante Migration auf Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.   Dabei verbindest Du Technologie und Business: Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Operations, Einkauf, Logistik und E-Commerce sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse, Daten und Systeme zuverlässig zusammenspielen.    Deine Aufgaben     ERP-Betrieb & Migration      Du verantwortest Betrieb, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2017.   Gemeinsam mit unserem Implementierungspartner steuerst Du die für 2027 geplante Migration auf Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.   Du koordinierst Anforderungen, Datenmigration, Tests sowie Cutover- und Go-Live-Vorbereitung.   Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Key Usern zusammen, begleitest Schulungen und sorgst für eine nachhaltige Nutzerakzeptanz.         Finance & Accounting      Du entwickelst unsere ERP-gestützten Finanz- und Buchhaltungsprozesse kontinuierlich weiter.   Du betreust die Finanzmodule – von Hauptbuch und Nebenbüchern bis zur Anlagenbuchhaltung.   Gemeinsam mit dem Group Accounting unterstützt Du Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse sowie Konsolidierungsprozesse.   Du sorgst für eine hohe Datenqualität und verlässliche Auswertungen und Reports.         Schnittstellen & Integrationen      Du verantwortest die ERP-seitigen Schnittstellen zu 3PL-Partnern, Shops und Marketplaces – von Bestellungen und Beständen bis zu Tracking- und Stammdaten. Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
About AQEMIA
 
AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.

title: Project Security Officer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Join us as a Project Security Officer, where you’ll be the primary security interface for the Nyx project, connecting Mission Operations with central security functions, engineering teams, suppliers, and external partners. You’ll translate requirements into practical, verifiable controls across our mission systems, working hands-on with engineers, technicians, and operators from concept through operations. Applications at all seniority levels are considered.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact for security-related topics on the Nyx project.

  • Translate company policies, customer requirements, regulations, and threat intelligence into project-specific security requirements, architectures, procedures, and verification criteria.

  • Maintain the integrated project security risk picture across cyber, physical, personnel, supply-chain, export-control, and security-architecture domains.

  • Flow security requirements into systems, subsystems, suppliers, and operations, and verify their implementation with objective evidence.

  • Work hands-on with engineers and the security team to implement secure configurations, access controls, segmentation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, encryption, and other cybersecurity controls.

  • Support threat modelling, risk assessments, security-by-design, system reviews, supplier assessments, security readiness, and assurance activities throughout the project lifecycle.

title: Technicien(ne) en robotique - Maintenance & SAV
description:
Dans le cadre du développement d'une de nos sociétés nous ouvrons un poste de Technicien(ne).
Principalement dedié à la distribution, le déploiement, la maintenance et le service après-vente de robots professionnels, avec un premier focus sur les robots de nettoyage.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre technique en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) en robotique – Maintenance & SAV.

Votre mission

Vous assurez le diagnostic, la réparation, la maintenance, la configuration et la mise en service de robots professionnels de nettoyage.

Vous intervenez sur les différents systèmes qui composent les robots :

  • Électronique & électricité : batteries, cartes électroniques, moteurs, capteurs, LiDAR, câblages
  • Software : configuration, mises à jour, firmware, navigation, analyse des erreurs et diagnostics
  • Circuits d’eau : pompes, tuyaux, vannes, filtres, réservoirs et recherche de fuites
  • Aspiration & nettoyage : moteurs d’aspiration, turbines, filtres, brosses et systèmes de lavage
  • Mécanique : roues, transmissions, moteurs, démontage, réparation et remplacement de composants

Vous serez également amené(e) à préparer les nouveaux robots, effectuer les maintenances préventives, intervenir chez nos clients en Suisse et collaborer avec les équipes techniques de nos fabricants internationaux.

Requirements

Nous recherchons une personne technique, polyvalente, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement d’une machine et rechercher l’origine d’une panne.

Formations recherchées :

  • Automaticien(ne) CFC
  • Mécatronicien(ne)
  • Électronicien(ne) CFC
  • Polymécanicien(ne) CFC
  • Technicien(ne) ES en systèmes industriels / automation
  • ou formation technique équivalente

title: Senior AI Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in?

At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field – not just in theory.


Your Role

You'll help build the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform, working across the full lifecycle – from pipeline design to production deployment. With 5+ years of experience under your belt, you're ready for the next step in your career. Maybe you've already mentored or technically guided colleagues, and you're looking to grow steadily into a Team Lead role as you take on more ownership and, over time, people responsibility.

The Technical ChallengeYou'll work on problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough". This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents you've never seen before, and where every accuracy gain has a direct, visible impact on our customers' daily operations.

description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

The mental model of this system has to live in your head, not in a context window. Use agents to move quickly on implementation. Do the design, the reasoning and the writing yourself, and be able to defend every decision you ship.

You see yourself as a game developer first and want to own the whole experience, not just a single feature? You love squad RPGs and know what makes a hero roster, a combat loop and a progression system click? For our new midcore mobile game we are looking for a Senior Game Designer who takes overall ownership for a great game - from first prototype to validation with real players. Join a small, experienced and fast-moving new games team and use AI as a natural part of your craft.

Your mission
  • Shape the game. Define the core loop, meta game and long-term progression of a new squad RPG together with Product, Art, and Tech - and take responsibility for the player experience as a whole. 
  • Design heroes and combat. Create hero rosters, abilities, synergies, and squad combat that are easy to learn and deep to master.
  • Balance the game. Set up the fundamentals of economy, progression and combat balancing that the game can grow on.
  • Prototype fast. Turn ideas into playable prototypes quickly, test them early and iterate based on player feedback and data.
  • Leverage AI. Use and drive AI tools and workflows for prototyping, content creation, balancing and analysis - and share your learnings with the team.
  • Validate. Contribute to market and player tests, interpret results and make clear, data-informed design decisions.

Your skill set

description:
Your Role
 
Als B2B Sales Development Representative spielst du eine zentrale Rolle im Wachstum von FINN. Du gewinnst neue Geschäftskunden, generierst hochwertige Leads und übergibst diese an unsere erfahrenen Account Executives. Dabei verstehst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Kundinnen, begeisterst sie für das Thema AutoAbo und kannst dein Know-how voll einbringen.
Die Rolle bietet dir die ideale Chance, deine Karriere im Sales aktiv zu gestalten und Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen. Du sammelst nicht nur wertvolle Vertriebserfahrungen, sondern trägst maßgeblich zur Entwicklung und Unterstützung unseres Teams bei. In unserem dynamischen Umfeld kannst du dein Vertriebstalent voll entfalten und deine berufliche Zukunft aktiv vorantreiben.

Your Mission

Anschließend stellst du eine reibungslose Übergabe an unsere B2B Account Executives sicher.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations (m/f/x)
description:
Your Role 

As Data Analyst in Operations at FINN, you will be at the heart of driving our business operations through data-driven insights. By leveraging advanced analytics tools and techniques, you will uncover trends, forecast outcomes, and provide actionable recommendations that validate the impact of strategic decisions. This role is perfect for a proactive problem solver who thrives in a data-rich environment. We’ve fully embraced AI-assisted development to amplify our impact, and we’re looking for a teammate who is excited to build and innovate using modern, AI-driven workflows too.


Your Responsibilities
  • Be a Domain Expert: As a domain expert, lead in-depth and advanced analysis of Operations data to uncover actionable insights that elevate performance and drive strategic decisions in areas like logistics, customer service, damage management, and risk assessment.
  • Own the semantics of Operations data: As the authority on Operations metrics, you ensure a unified data language across the domain. By standardizing key terminology, you enable deeper insights and faster decision-making for accelerated growth and improved operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Craft Compelling Narratives: Transform complex data into visually stunning dashboards, reports and appealing data stories that tell a clear status and allow actionable insights.
  • Be a Data Evangelist: Partner with cross-functional business, tech teams and data teams to continuously enhance data processes and tools, ensuring every move is backed by cutting-edge analytics.

    • Your Profile
  • Graduated with a Master’s degree in a quantitative field of study.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in data analytics with a focus on Operations Domain at a scaleup.
  • Advanced SQL

title: Senior Product Manager - ARR & Subscriptions (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (m/f/d) to build the subscription platform and the customer experience behind our recurring revenue. You own the journey from the first booking step to contract and activation, including everything customers see and use when they sign up, for subscriptions such as Heartbeat AI with Dynamic Pulse, service contracts for PV systems and batteries, and maintenance contracts for heat pumps. Your goal is to launch new products in new markets fast: a platform where offerings, prices and promotions are set up in minutes, and where every step from booking to activation converts.
As a Senior Product Manager you will

  • set the product strategy and roadmap for booking and subscriptions, and be accountable for growing recurring revenue
  • improve conversion along the customer journey through discovery, customer insight and A/B tests

Teamet hjælper hver dag kunder via telefon og digitale kanaler med blandt andet konti, betalinger, digitale løsninger og generel vejledning. Din primære arbejdsplads er Aarhus, og du får tæt kontakt med lederkolleger, specialister og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af banken. I hverdagen arbejder du med både drift, mennesker og forbedringer, så teamet kan levere enkel, professionel og relevant kundeservice.   I det daglige vil du:     lede teamets daglige drift og sikrer klare rammer for arbejdet.  udvikle medarbejdere gennem sparring, opfølgning og tydelig prioritering.  styrke kvaliteten i kundeoplevelsen gennem struktur og løbende forbedringer.  omsætte bankens strategi Forward ’28 til konkrete initiativer i teamet.  skabe samarbejde på tværs af Customer Care og resten af Danske Bank.     Vi forventer, at du     har erfaring med personaleledelse og udvikling af medarbejdere.  kommunikerer klart og skaber retning gennem dialog og involvering.  har erfaring med forandringsledelse og praktisk gennemførelse.  arbejder struktureret med mål, kvalitet og kundeoplevelser.  har erfaring fra service, kundecenter, finans eller lignende kundevendte miljøer.    Det er en fordel, hvis du kender til erhvervskunder eller daglige bankforretninger. Det vigtigste er, at du kan lede et team med mange kontaktflader og skabe gode rammer for både kunder og medarbejdere.   Hvad vi tilbyder dig   Du får en synlig lederrolle i et område, der har stor betydning for Danske Banks erhvervskunder. Vi arbejder efter en hybrid model med 3-4 dage på kontoret om ugen og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale. Du får tæt sparring med erfarne lederkolleger, gode muligheder for personlig og ledelsesmæssig udvikling og et bredt netværk på tværs af organisationen.   Er du klar til næste skridt?   Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mai Skjold Jensen, Head of Customer Care DK, på maije@danskebank.dk.  Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning, når du er klar. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Coretura is building the software backbone for the next generation of commercial vehicles - a joint venture between two of the industry's biggest players, moving at scaleup speed. As Customer Success Manager, you'll sit at the center of that relationship, turning shareholder alignment into product momentum.    Our Vision & Mission   Coretura exists to build a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform that redefines how commercial vehicles are engineered, updated, and monetized - jointly owned by Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, two competitors who are betting that shared infrastructure beats separate roads. Our mission is to deliver a common platform robust enough to serve multiple OEMs, while still giving each shareholder room to differentiate and win in their own markets. This is a company in active build-mode: fast-scaling, still shaping its own structures, and defined by the ambition to make software the center of gravity in trucking.   Your Quest   Coretura serves two OEM shareholders who are simultaneously its customers, a structural setup that creates constant, real tension: whose priorities get championed first, how do you keep a platform genuinely common when both owners want to differentiate, and what happens when one side's ask risks disadvantaging the other?  On top of that, the product itself is still under creation, and that creation often means guiding a broader shift from hardware-centric thinking toward a software-first mindset. We are building the platform and bringing the customers along for the ride at the same time, which makes for a different kind of relationship than you'd have with an established product. This calls for someone who can stay close to the customer commercially and relationally, build a genuine business case for why and how they engage with the platform, set and manage realistic expectations continuously, and be comfortable challenging the customer with integrity and assertiveness, all while never losing sight of the platform's value in the eyes of the customer.  This is where the Customer Success Manager comes in. You are the person who holds the customer relationship end-to-end, deeply representing your customer's interests, building the commercial and business rationale for their engagement with the platform, and making sure that rationale is heard by the people who shape the platform. The Customer Success Manager keeps their ears & eyes close to the customer organization, actively owning and driving the customer relationship to ensure a successful SDV platform in its rollout and operation.   The Value You Bring     You turn a structural relationship into a working partnership, so the customer feels heard, represented, and commercially engaged, not just serviced.  You manage expectations proactively around a product that's still being built, keeping the customer aligned and confident even as scope and timelines evolve.  You uncover customer needs early and turn them into concrete business opportunit

title: Senior Account Manager
description: Job Description   Danske Bank i Norge er en offensiv, rendyrket bank for næringslivskunder.  Danske Finans har ansvaret for leasingfinansiering i Danske Bank-konsernet. Vi jobber med kunder innenfor investeringstunge bransjer og har en målsetting om å fortsette vår sterke vekst fremover. Du blir en del av et erfarent og faglig sterkt team med kolleger som vil lykkes.  Ditt arbeidssted vil være i Danske Bank sine kontorer på Aker Brygge i Oslo eller Søndre gate i Trondheim. I rollen vil det være noe reisevirksomhet, samt gode muligheter for hjemmekontor. Du må ha førerkort og disponere bil.   Relasjonsbygger med kremmerånd   I det daglige jobber du med noen av bankens mest interessante og profesjonelle bedriftskunder innenfor mange ulike bransjer. Du får ansvar for salg av leasing og rådgivning i tett samarbeid med eget team og kundeansvarlige i banken. Som Account Manager / Senior Account Manager er du ansvarlig for å utvikle eksisterende kundeforhold, samt å innhente nye kunder via akkvisisjon.   Ønsket kompetanse og personlige egenskaper    Riktig kandidat for stillingen har høyere utdannelse (gjerne innenfor økonomi) og relevant erfaring, fortrinnsvis fra salgsarbeid og gjerne innenfor bedriftsmarked. Det er en fordel om du kan vise til gode resultater, er forhandlingsvant og skaper tillit hos kundene. Som person ønsker vi at du er profesjonell, initiativrik og omgjengelig slik at du naturlig faller innenfor Danske Banks kulturelle forpliktelser – Team up, Own it, Be open.   Vi tilbyr   Som Account Manager / Senior Account Manager vil du få spennende utfordringer i et fleksibelt, positivt og aktivt arbeidsmiljø! Teamet består av dyktige ansatte som spiller hverandre gode. Du vil få en selvstendig rolle med mye ansvar, attraktive kunder og varierte oppgaver.  Som ansatt i Danske Bank vil du inkluderes i gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Du vil ha tilgang på firmahytter, trening i arbeidstiden og ekstra fridager i forbindelse med sommer- og julefri. Vi holder til i topp moderne lokaler på Aker Brygge i Oslo samt Søndre gt. i Trondheim, der vi blant annet har et svært godt kantinealternativ.  Danske Bank verdsetter mangfold i ansettelsene vi gjør. Dette innebærer å skape en arbeidsplass hvor individuelle forskjeller blir verdsatt, respektert og benyttet på en måte som gjør at hver enkelt person kan få brukt sine individuelle styrker og talenter til det fulle.   Interessert?   Synes du dette høres spennende ut? Da håper vi du sender inn søknaden din innen 25. oktober. Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte salgsjef Kjell Trøan på telefon 415 00 424 eller Senior Account Manager Linn Tove Hansen på telefon 918 81 650.

title: Key Account Manager Vesterålen - Ledige stillinger - Avonova Helse AS
description: Avonova søker en erfaren Key Account Manager som kan kombinere solid HMS-kompetanse med sterk forretningsforståelse.  Vi ser etter deg som evner å omsette arbeidsmiljø, helse og sikkerhet til konkret verdi for kunden gjennom redusert risiko, økt produktivitet og et mer bærekraftig arbeidsliv. Som KAM hos oss får du ansvar for en egen portefølje av større kunder. Du bygger sterke relasjoner med ledere og beslutningstakere, identifiserer behov og bidrar til at kundene lykkes med sitt HMS- og arbeidsmiljøarbeid.  Det må påregnes noe reisevirksomhet i rollen og du må disponere egen bil.   Dine viktigste ansvarsområder      Strategisk rådgivning innen arbeidsmiljø, HMS og organisatorisk utvikling   Videreutvikling av egen kundeportefølje gjennom tett oppfølging og sterk forretningsforståelse   Rådgivning til ledere, HR, vernetjeneste og arbeidsmiljøutvalg   Deltakelse i AMU og andre sentrale kundeprosesser   Koordinering av tverrfaglige leveranser fra Avonovas fagmiljøer   Bidra til høy kundetilfredshet, lojalitet og langsiktig verdiskaping      Vi ser etter deg som har      Høyere utdanning innen HMS, arbeidsmiljø, HR, organisasjon, ledelse eller tilsvarende   Solid erfaring med systematisk HMS-arbeid og arbeidsmiljøutvikling   Erfaring fra rådgivning mot ledere og beslutningstakere   God forretningsforståelse og evne til å se sammenhengen mellom arbeidsmiljø, risiko, sykefravær og virksomhetsresultater   Erfaring med kundeansvar, relasjonsbygging eller Key Account Management er en fordel      Personlige egenskaper      Du skaper tillit og bygger sterke relasjoner   Du er faglig trygg og trives i rollen som rådgiver   Du er kommersiell, proaktiv og løsningsorientert   Du evner å balansere faglig tyngde med gode kundeopplevelser   Du arbeider strukturert og selvstendig      Vi tilbyr      En sentral rolle hos Norges ledende bedriftshelsetjeneste   Mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen hos noen av våre viktigste kunder   Et av landets sterkeste fagmiljøer innen arbeidshelse og HMS   Gode utviklingsmuligheter, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger   Kontorplass i Sortland og noe reisevirksomhet til våre kunder    Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer deg til å søke så snart som mulig.  Om arbeidsplassen  Avonova er Nordens største bedriftshelsetjeneste (BHT). Hver dag – tidlig og sent – ønsker vi å utgjøre en reell forskjell for tusenvis av arbeidstakere, i tråd med samfunnsoppdraget vi skal levere på. Derfor finner du oss i totalt 130 byer i Norge, Sverige og Finland, tett på våre kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Med ledende ekspertise innen arbeidsmedisin, sykefravær, fysisk og psykososialt arbeidsmiljø, får du aktivt ta del i et bunnsolid fagmiljø med mer enn 1300 dyktige og hyggelige kolleger i tre nordiske land. Vi ser etter deg som finner glød og engasjement i å videreutvikle våre tjenester og tilbud, på vei mot bærekraftige arbeidsplasser som fremmer helse, mangfold og respekt.

title: Asiakasvastaava, Liikenne
description: Position Description    CGI on yksi suurimmista IT- ja liiketoimintakonsultoinnin yrityksistä Suomessa ja maailmalla. Vahva kokemuksemme eri toimialoilta auttaa julkisen ja yksityisen sektorin asiakkaitamme onnistumaan digitaalisessa muutoksessa ja saavuttamaan tavoitteitaan entistä tehokkaammin.      Asiakasvastaava, Liikenne    Haemme asiakasvastaavaa osaksi liikenteen organisaatiotamme kehittämään asiakassuhteitamme ja kasvattamaan yhteistyötä merkittävien suomalaisten yritysten ja organisaatioiden kanssa.  Asiakasvastaavana tehtäväsi on ymmärtää asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaa, tavoitteita ja muuttuvia tarpeita sekä auttaa löytämään niihin sopivia ratkaisuja yhdessä CGI:n asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Rakennat aktiivisesti verkostoja nimettyjen asiakkaiden organisaatioissa, käyt keskustelua eri sidosryhmien kanssa ja tunnistat uusia yhteistyön ja liiketoiminnan mahdollisuuksia sekä viet nämä eteenpäin konkreettisiksi palveluiksi ja hankkeiksi. Osallistut lisäksi yksikömme omien keihäänkärkitarjoamien kehittämiseen ja myymiseen.  Roolissa yhdistyvät asiakkuuksien kehittäminen, konsultoiva myynti ja ymmärrys IT-konsultoinnin ja projektien käytännön toteuttamisesta. Onnistuminen tehtävässä edellyttää kykyä kuunnella ja kysyä, muodostaa kokonaiskuva asiakkaan tilanteesta sekä soveltaa CGI:n tarjoamaa ja osaamista asiakkaan tarpeisiin. Työskentelet tiiviisti CGI:n asiantuntijoiden ja toimitustiimien kanssa sekä tuet asiakasprojektien ja palveluiden onnistumista.  Odotamme kokemusta IT-konsultointipalveluiden myymisestä, mutta tehtävä voi sopia myös esim. IT-projektien tai asiakastoimitusten vetämisestä kokemusta kerryttäneelle henkilölle, joka haluaa seuraavaksi kasvattaa vastuutaan asiakkuuksien kehittämisessä, konsultoivassa myynnissä ja kaupallisessa työssä.    Asiakasvastaavana      Rakennat ja kehität pitkäaikaisia suhteita nimetyissä asiakkuuksissa sekä laajennat aktiivisesti verkostoasi asiakkaiden organisaatioissa.  Perehdyt asiakkaiden liiketoimintaan, tavoitteisiin ja haasteisiin sekä tunnistat keskustelujen kautta uusia tarpeita ja yhteistyömahdollisuuksia.  Viet tunnistettuja liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia aktiivisesti eteenpäin yhdessä CGI:n asiantuntijoiden kanssa.  Edistät asiakkaidemme tekoälykiihdytettyä ohjelmistokehitystä ja liiketoiminnan kehitystä.  Vastaat myös tämän alueen konseptiemme kaupallistamisesta ja myynnistä.  Osallistut konsultoivaan myyntiin ratkaisujen ja tarjousten muodostamisesta sopimusneuvotteluihin.  Hyödynnät projektitoimituksista kertynyttä ymmärrystä asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toteutettavien ratkaisujen yhteensovittamisessa.  Työskentelet tiiviisti projektien ja palveluiden toimitustiimien kanssa ja tuet asiakkuuden näkökulmasta toimitusten onnistumista.  Vastaat sovituista asiakkuus- ja myyntitavoitteista sekä edistät asiakkuuksien pitkäjänteistä kasvua.    Työskentelemme Helsingissä, ja tehtävään kuuluu asiakkaiden tapaamista kasvokkain sekä liikkumista asiakkaidemme luona.    Edellytämme sinulta     Koke

title: Customer Experience Manager - Danish
description: We’re hiring someone to take over the voice our customers meet. ☀️      For years, Christian (aka Mr. Shade) has answered every Baser customer himself. 7am emails before the school run. Personal videos filmed from the beach, the park, a backyard. Conversations that start with parasols and drift into Lego, Star Wars, or how someone’s week is going.  That’s our kind of service. We talk to customers like a friend’s friend who asked us at a barbecue which parasol to buy, and we help them choose the one that’s right for them. That isn’t always the most expensive one.     Now Christian is ready to hand the daily customer work to someone who shares his instinct for it, so he can focus on product, brand and content.      The role: Customer Experience Manager → Chief of Customer Experience   You’ll own the full inbox with Christian across Denmark, Germany, the UK, Australia and the US. Christian trains you until the voice is yours. That covers pre-sale advice, video consultations, logistics, spare parts, warranty, and day-to-day support for B2B partners like Bauhaus. You’ll take a function that mostly lives in Christian’s head and inbox and turn it into something that scales, using the FAQ library and templates we’ve already drafted.     As we grow, regional peers will join you. The first is an Australia-focused CX manager by mid-2027. You’ll be the senior anchor of that team.      You might be the one if you:   → Fluent Danish, fluent English (Norwegian or Swedish is a real plus)   → Light up in conversation and genuinely care about helping customers make the right choice for them   → Have built SOPs, FAQs or response libraries before, and see chaos as an invitation   → Use AI daily   → Are comfortable on camera, in a warm and personal way, not polished   → Want to master a craft, not just do a job — personally trained by Christian until the voice is yours   → Want a real seat at the table in a small, founder-led team     The job is remote anywhere in Europe and full-time. Hours are flexible, but the seasonal peaks are real. You’re ON when the season is on and genuinely OFF when it isn’t. Spring/summer 2027 is the big one, with our new website launch and our biggest European season yet.        The application is a little different. Watch Christian’s video, look at a customer’s garden, and record yourself giving them advice on your phone. We don’t care if you pick the “right” parasol. We want to see how you talk and how you’d make someone feel.     Full details and the task are here: https://mybaser.dk/jobs/customer-experience-manager  We hire slow, and we hire for personality.     We’ll start reviewing applications from 25 October — make sure yours lands before then. First interviews early November, and we want the right person to start as soon as they can.      Du læste helt til bunden. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.   #hiring #customerexperience #remote #danishjobs #danishexpats #danskeriudlandet #customerservice

description: AZIENDA   La nostra azienda cliente è parte di un Gruppo industriale tra i primi a livello mondiale nella progettazione e realizzazione di macchine e impianti per il settore Bakery e Food. L'evoluzione che sta attraversando ha portato all'ingresso di Clienti sempre più strutturati, complessi e altamente esigenti e per rispondere con la massima efficacia a questi standard elevati, l'azienda intende inserire questa figura chiave a potenziamento della gestione e della cura del Cliente nel post-vendita.      POSIZIONE   La risorsa risponderà funzionalmente al Responsabile dei Progetti (figura cresciuta internamente a partire dal medesimo ruolo) e si interfaccerà con le funzioni aziendali chiave (R&D, Ufficio Tecnico, Commerciale).  Più che una figura di pura operatività tecnica (per la quale l'azienda dispone già di specialisti dedicati), la ricerca è rivolta a un profilo dotato di spiccata maturità relazionale e capacità di gestione strutturata del Cliente, in grado di filtrare le richieste, gestire momenti di stress e governare la crescente complessità procedurale, documentale e di sicurezza (certificazioni CE, conformità per i mercati esteri, ecc.).      Responsabilità principali:    Gestione Clienti & Interfaccia Interna: interagisce in modo autorevole con direttori tecnici, responsabili di manutenzione o proprietà, facendo da filtro efficace tra le richieste di assistenza della grande industria e i reparti interni (R&D, Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione).  Coordinamento del Team: guida e valorizza un team affiatato e collaborativo di 5 risorse.  Pianificazione & Ricambi: gestisce e schedula gli interventi di assistenza (sul campo e da remoto) e il flusso dei ricambi per i clienti strategici.  Compliance & Documentazione: supervisiona la documentazione tecnica, le procedure di sicurezza e le certificazioni specifiche per i mercati esteri.  Sviluppo Service: sviluppa progressivamente i servizi di manutenzione preventiva e assistenza digitale.       REQUISITI   Lo scopo principale della posizione è garantire la gestione d'eccellenza del service e della ricambistica, focalizzandosi sul coordinamento e sulla tenuta della relazione con i Clienti, con particolare focus verso quelli che rappresentano la grande industria.   Cerchiamo professionisti con esperienza consolidata nel post-vendita, Customer Service o assistenza tecnica presso aziende produttrici di macchine/impianti industriali (la provenienza dallo specifico settore non è vincolante).  La figura ideale si distingue per una forte maturità relazionale, autocontrollo e diplomazia, indispensabili per gestire le aspettative e le pressioni dei clienti della grande industria multinazionale.   Si richiedono inoltre un approccio rigoroso alla gestione documentale/certificativa, una leadership collaborativa, un'ottima padronanza dell'inglese e la disponibilità a brevi e occasionali trasferte.      Pacchetto retributivo indicativo: € 50.000 - 60.000

title: Palveluvastaava, Työkyvyn palvelut
description: Haemme kokenutta ammatillisen kuntoutuksen ammattilaista palveluvastaavaksi Pihlajalinnan Työkyvyn palveluihin.    Me pihlajalinnalaiset  teemme yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävää työtä suomalaisen terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi vaikuttavasti ja vastuullisesti. Toimintamme keskiössä on lupaus auttaa ihmisiä elämään parempaa elämää. Kiinnitämme erityistä huomiota esihenkilötyöhön ja sitoudumme yhtiön johtamisperiaatteisiin: mahdollistan kasvun, kannan vastuun, otan mukaan, välitän ja olen reilu. Autamme toisiamme onnistumaan ja luomme ympärillemme iloista, mutkatonta ja turvallista työarkea.  Arvostamme Pihlajalinnassa työyhteisön moninaisuutta ja teemme töitä yhdenvertaisuuden eteen. Palveluvastaavan rooli on monipuolinen ja ammatillisesti mielenkiintoinen. Kyseessä on tehtävä, jossa pääset rakentamaan, kehittämään ja varmistamaan palvelutuotantoa sekä vaikuttamaan liiketoiminnan tavoitteiden toteutumiseen. Toimit laajassa yhteistyöverkostossa sisäisten sidosryhmien; ammatillisen kuntoutuksen ja työterveyden sekä työeläke- ja vakuutusyhtiöiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Vastaat työsi kautta työkyvyn palveluiden laadun varmistamisesta ja luot edellytykset tiimiläistesi onnistumiselle.  Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti etänä. Kasvokkaiset tapaamiset järjestämme useimmiten Helsingin tai Tampereen hallinnon tiloissamme, jonne toivomme sinun pääsevän tarvittaessa paikan päälle. Tavoitteenamme on, että uusi palveluvastaava aloittaisi meillä marraskuussa 2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.   💡 Olisitko sinä seuraava pihlajalinnalainen?  Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen työn, mahdollisuuden kehittää ja kehittyä, kannustavan työyhteisön; erittäin kokeneen ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin sekä yrityksen tuen menestyä tehtävässä. title: Chargé(e) d’Onboarding Client FR/EN (H/F)
description: Chez Ringover, un contrat signé n’est que le début. Ce qui compte, c’est le moment où le client passe son premier appel, adopte l’outil et n’a plus de questions. Entre la signature et ce moment, il y a toi.  Tu prends le relais dès la signature. Ton rôle : faire en sorte que chaque nouveau client, en France comme à l’international, démarre vite et bien. Tu es le chef d’orchestre de l’onboarding. Tu lances, tu coordonnes, tu débloques, puis tu clôtures le parcours quand le client est autonome.   Tes missions    Lancer vite     Finaliser les étapes administratives et déclencher la facturation dans les 24 h qui suivent la signature.  Contacter rapidement chaque nouveau client et planifier les kick-offs et les formations selon ses disponibilités.     Orchestrer l’onboarding     Mobiliser les bonnes personnes au bon moment : CSM, Support, TAM, Sales Ops, équipes Projet.  Suivre chaque onboarding dans nos outils et tenir les jalons et les délais. Débloquer et faire adopter     Repérer en amont ce qui risque de freiner l’activation ou l’adoption, et faire appel aux bons experts en interne pour le régler.
