title: Bankspecialist til erhvervskunder og finansielle institutioner
description: Vil du arbejde tæt på nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder, institutionelle investorer og internationale banker?  I Large Corporates & Institutions søger vi en ny kollega til en specialistrolle, hvor du får en alsidig hverdag med fokus på kundesupport, lånehåndtering, onboarding og kundekendskab for nogle af bankens største erhvervskunder, institutionelle investorer og internationale banker.  Du bliver en del af et erfarent team og kommer tæt på komplekse og betydningsfulde kunderelationer. Du får en hverdag med kontakt til kunder, rådgivere, banker og specialister samt en vigtig rolle i den daglige drift og udvikling af vores processer og kundeløsninger.  Om rollen  Du får en alsidig rolle med opgaver inden for både kunde- og lånesupport samt kundeoprettelse, dokumentation og kundedata. Opgaverne er fordelt nogenlunde ligeligt mellem de to områder.  Kunde- og lånesupport  Du får en central rolle i den daglige håndtering af kundesager samt koordinering mellem kunder, rådgivere og specialister.  Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet:     Daglig support og koordinering vedrørende lån, betalinger, garantier, fuldmagter og øvrige kundehenvendelser.  Opfølgning på kredit- og cash management-opgaver.  Bidrage til håndtering af syndikerede lån, covenant-overvågning og ændringer på eksisterende faciliteter.   Håndtering af service- og administrationsopgaver relateret til fondsmæglerselskaber og bankens datterselskaber.     Kundeoprettelse, dokumentation og kundedata  Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med onboarding af kunder, kundekendskab og løbende opdatering af kundedata og dokumentation.  Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:     Onboarding af nye kunder, herunder indsamling af dokumentation og systemmæssig oprettelse.  Deltage i den løbende håndtering af kundekendskab på erhvervskunder m.v.   Vedligeholdelse og optimering af arbejdsgange inden for området  Opdatering og kvalitetssikring af dokumentation på handlemodparter mv.     Rollen er kendetegnet ved stor variation, hvor du i løbet af en uge både kan arbejde med kundedialog, lånehåndtering, onboarding af nye kunder samt kvalitetssikring af kundedata og dokumentation.  Din profil  Du har en finansiel baggrund og erfaring fra f.eks. erhvervsområdet, kredit, kundeservice, back office, KYC/AML, cash management eller lignende funktioner i den finansielle sektor.  Du skaber værdi gennem professionel kundehåndtering, høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen og en stærk serviceorientering. Du motiveres af at udvikle din faglighed inden for erhvervsområdet og arbejdet med finansielle institutioner.  Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:     Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer  Trives med mange parallelle opgaver og bevarer overblikket  Kan samarbejde på tværs af organisationen  Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk  Har mod på at lære nye fagområder     Det får du hos os  Du får en sjælden mulighed for at arbejde tæt på nogle af bankens største erhvervskunder, institutionelle investor

title: Release Manager
description: About Six Robotics   At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible.  From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world.  The challenges we work on don’t come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve.  At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you’re excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact.   About The Role   We are looking for a dedicated Release Manager to own the execution and coordination of our quarterly releases, from the first planning session until the software is ready to be shipped to our customers.  This role is needed as the organization grows, and so does the complexity of our product development and engineering work. The Engineering teams are organised by discipline rather than by feature, which means deliveries depend on cross-team collaboration across Engineering, design, and testing. Until now, release coordination has been handled alongside other roles. As we scale, we need one person in Engineering who owns the release, sees the full picture and makes sure every team knows what it needs from the others to deliver on time and agreed quality.  You will make sure our releases are realistically scoped, that dependencies between teams surface early, and that code freeze, branch-off and backporting run smoothly. You will be the bridge between Product, who defines what we want to build, and Engineering, who knows what is possible. Going forward, you will also bring Operations, Customer Success and other stakeholders into a more structured release process.  Your impact in the first year. You will turn release coordination into a clear, repeatable system. Team Leads will know what they depend on and when. Stakeholders will have real-time visibility into progress and risks. Engineering teams will work towards goals that are predictable and achievable, without unsustainable pressure.   What success looks like after 6–12 months:     Public releases ship on time and with high quality  Delivery risks and issues are identified and addressed early  Stakeholders have clear visibility into progress, scope changes and risks  Engineering teams experience predictable goals, and internal roadmaps become a source of motivation  Release processes are structured and scalable

We want to help change those numbers by creating a collaborative and supportive environment at Octopus Energy Trading, one where women in data science can build confidence, sharpen their technical craft, and step into lead roles.

title: Staff Research Scientist- Interactive Avatars
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Staff Research Scientist, you will join a team of 40+ researchers and engineers in our R&D department, working on the frontier of generative AI with a focus on avatar-centric, interactive video diffusion models.

This is a unique opportunity for experts in machine learning and diffusion models to shape the future of AI video agents that listen, respond, and react like humans. As part of our Interactive Avatars team, you'll build models that hold natural, real-time conversations: understanding what a user says and how they say it, then responding with appropriate turn-taking, backchannels, gaze, and facial and body reactions. You'll join a team that moves fast, iterates often, and turns breakthrough research into product capabilities that ship.


What you'll do

  • Set the research direction and roadmap for dyadic interaction modeling, balancing long-term bets with near-term product impact.

Vous concevrez et développerez des briques logicielles d'automatisation (notamment via EnOSlib) pour le déploiement de charges GenAI distribuées. title: Initiativbewerbung
description:
Wer sind wir?

Wir, die XLETIX GmbH, sind Marktführer für Hindernislaufveranstaltungen in Europa mit Sitz in Berlin. Wir organisieren und vermarkten die Sportveranstaltungen XLETIX Challenge presented by MaxiNutrition, schauinsland Muddy Angel Run und XLETIX Kids für jährlich über 250.000 Sportbegeisterte in Deutschland, Österreich, Frankreich, Belgien und in der Schweiz. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen durch Sport zu begeistern.

Dein Job ist nicht mit dabei?

Möchtest du ein Praktikum absolvieren oder suchst du eine Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit? Dann melde dich bei uns. Wir bieten aktuell folgende Bereiche an: Finance, HR, Operations (Event Management), Sponsoring, Performance Marketing, Online Marketing und Teilnehmendenkommunikation.

Was wir bieten:

  • Ein tolles Team, das die Firmenwerte lebt und schätzt #ETEZ -Ein Team, Ein Ziel!

  • Vielfältige Möglichkeiten für deine Weiterentwicklung

  • Viel Spielraum für eigenverantwortliches Handeln in einem aufgeschlossenen Team

  • Einen Platz in einem stylischen Büro im Herzen Berlins, in dem sich auch regelmäßig ein Vierbeiner (Hund) zu uns gesellt sowie der Möglichkeit zum hybriden Arbeiten.

  • Eine gute Mischung aus Schreibtisch-Job und unterstützenden Tätigkeiten auf unseren Sportveranstaltungen

  • Eine kostenlose Mitgliedschaft beim Urban Sports Club, eine Bahncard 25 und vieles mehr

  • Firmenevents, die genauso leidenschaftlich geplant und sensationell wie unsere Sportveranstaltungen sind

  • Ein Netzwerk aus internationalen und erfahrenen Kollegen, die du in regelmäßigen Meetings triffst

Wir freuen uns auf deine Initiativbewerbung!

title: Experte für technische Dokumentation Ersatzteilmanagement ASD S2000M (m/w/d)
description:
Projektbeschreibung:

Technologie begeistert Sie? Uns auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Verteidigungsbranche suchen wir einen Experten für technische Dokumentation Ersatzteilmanagement ASD S2000M (m/w/d) in Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie persönlich kennen zu lernen - und gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft und Teamgeist an spannenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien zu arbeiten.

  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen nach ASD S2000M und DB Spec 2000M

title: Senior Software Developer (m/w/d) ELMI AI Plattform (Berlin/Bonn/Frankfurt)
description:
Baue die Softwareplattform, die unsere Ladeinfrastruktur intelligent macht!

ELMI Power entwickelt und vertreibt batteriegestützte DC-Schnellladestationen und Batteriespeichersysteme. Mit ELMI AI bauen wir jetzt die softwareseitige Ergänzung dazu auf: eine Plattform, die unsere Ladestationen und Batteriespeicher intelligent steuert – sie liest und verarbeitet Daten aus dem Energiemanagementsystem, analysiert Preise umliegender Ladestationen und passt die eigene Preisgestaltung dynamisch an, optimiert Nachladestrategien der internen Batterie und betreibt aktiven Energiehandel. Ein Produktmanager ist bereits an Bord, erste Modul-Prototypen (MVP) existieren – jetzt geht es darum, daraus ein robustes, produktionsreifes Softwareprodukt zu bauen.

Du bist erfahrener Software Engineer mit Architektur-Know-how, hast schon mit AWS-Infrastruktur gearbeitet – und willst selbst coden und Verantwortung für deine Module übernehmen? Du willst ein Produkt von der ersten stabilen Version an mitgestalten, statt in einem gewachsenen System nur zu verwalten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

title: Head of Finance & Controlling
description:
Wir suchen dich als

Head of Finance & Controlling (all genders) – für eine Rolle, in der du eine verlässliche Finance-Basis mit vorausschauendem Controlling und fundierten Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Business verbindest.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. description:
Wer wir sind

  

RNA Digital Solutions wurde 2016 als Industrial Tech Startup gegründet. Unsere Expertise liegt im Digitalen Maschinenbau und wir beschäftigen uns insbesondere mit der digitalen Auslegung und Herstellung automatisierter Zuführlösungen. In 2021 erfolgte der Anschluss des Startups an den Weltmarktführer in der Zuführtechnik, der Rhein-Nadel-Automation GmbH. Unser Fokus liegt zu 100% auf der Softwareentwicklung. Unsere Software-Teams verteilen sich auf die Standorte München und Aachen. In München entwickeln wir unsere Dienste für Künstliche Intelligenz und Simulation. In Aachen nutzen wir die Nähe zum Shop Floor für Sonder-Digitalisierungsprojekte und Shop Floor-bezogene Software. 

Die Kombination von jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung im Bereich Zuführtechnik gepaart mit modernsten Technologien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz ermöglicht es uns, die Zuführtechnik von Morgen zu entwickeln.

  • Entwicklung: Du treibst zusammen mit dem Team den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung interner Apps zur Prozessdigitalisierung und -automatisierung voran. Die React-basierten Apps kommunizieren über REST mit verschiedenen Django-Backends/-Microservices. Die containerbasierte Architektur umfasst auch KI-/ML-Module sowie automatisierte Physik-Simulationen.
  • Aufgabenspektrum: Du wirkst von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zur Auslieferung mit.
  • Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld und stehst im engen Kontakt mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um Nutzeranforderungen zu verstehen und umzusetzen.

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.


Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.


Why join us?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

title: Senior Design Quality Engineer
description:
Senior Design Quality Engineer

In Brief

We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll safeguard product quality for an FDA-cleared, AI-driven clinical platform, from design controls while we build, to complaint investigation once it's live in hospitals, to the quality system and regulatory record that hold it all together.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes.

About the Role

Bayesian ships FDA-cleared, AI clinical decision support software directly into Epic and Oracle Health workflows at health systems across the country. Every release, every model update, and every clinician report that an alert didn't behave as expected runs through a quality and regulatory system that has to be as rigorous as the software itself. You will help drive that system.

This role intentionally wears multiple hats. We're a small company, and we need one person who can do several things well: engineer quality into the software as it's built, handle the post-market side once it's in production, and keep the quality management system and our regulatory obligations current as we scale. You'll work directly with engineering, data science, clinical, and implementation teams, with support from company leadership, while under the direction of the Head of Quality and Regulatory.

You're the engineer in the room on quality questions. When a hospital reports that the model flagged a patient late, you decide whether it's a complaint, whether it's reportable, and what changed in the software or the data. You can read the code, the logs, and the test evidence to find out.

What You'll Own

Software Design Quality

Partner with engineering and data science through the full software lifecycle: requirements, architecture review, software risk analysis, verification and validation, traceability, and release readiness in accordance with IEC 62304, ISO 14971,

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Active Intelligence is already live — autonomous agents serving 180,000+ businesses, with real traction and a roadmap that gets more ambitious with every release. What we need now is the product leader who accelerates the layer that makes all of it smarter.

This is a principal-level IC role focused on two connected problem spaces: the context intelligence layer that gives Active Intelligence its depth, and the deep reasoning agent that turns that depth into marketing insight no other platform can deliver. You’ll work alongside our Head of Applied AI, Head of Active Intelligence Engineering, and a team of product leaders who are each driving pieces of the autonomous marketing vision. Your piece is arguably the most leveraged — because everything else in the platform gets better when context and reasoning get better.

We ship fast, iterate in days not quarters, and expect product managers to own outcomes end-to-end — from prototype to production to in-market adoption. If you’re looking for a role where scope is handed to you and success is defined for you, this isn’t it. If you want to define both, keep reading.

What You'll Do:

Partner with Applied AI Teams to Build the Context Layer. Define and ship the structured intelligence layer that gives Active Intelligence deep understanding of each customer’s business — their goals, brand, audience behavior, campaign history, and what’s actually working. This is the signal architecture that turns 20+ years of marketing data into something every agent on the platform can reason over. You lead how context matures, what signals matter, and how it compounds across the product.

Build the Deep Reasoning Agent. Leverage frontier model capabilities — extended thinking, multi-step research, cross-source synthesis — to create a marketing intelligence agent that actually thinks about what’s happening. Not dashboard summaries. Deep analysis: why engagement shifted, what top-performing segments share, where the next campaign should focus and why. You define what “deep” means in a marketing context and ship something that makes static reporting feel obsolete.

Connect the flywheel. The reasoning agent without context is a wrapper. The context layer without a flagship consumer is infrastructure. You own the loop where deeper context produces more powerful reasoning, which drives more engagement, which generates richer context.

Own quality and evaluation. Design the eval frameworks — golden sets, quality rubrics, output grading — that determine whether the reasoning agent is actually good, not just impressive in a demo. You set the bar for what “marketing-grade intelligence” means and build the measurement systems to hold it.

Operate as a technically credible builder. You prototype with frontier models directly, test prompt architectures, and challenge engineering on system design

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About AQEMIA

AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.

title: Principal Biologist
description:
About AQEMIA

AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first:

title: Head of Hardware
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat.

title: Applied AI - Member of Technical Staff
description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ;
  • Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ;
  • Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille.

Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond :

title: Brand lead
description:
About H:

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

The Role

Today, H is known for its story: its founders, its funding rounds, its press. We want it to be known for its value. Your mission is to make H one of the top 3 brands that large-enterprise decision-makers think of in enterprise AI, in France first, then in the US.

You will be our Brand lead, and the owner of the Brand pillar of our marketing strategy, alongside Growth and Product Marketing. You'll take over a brand foundation that is being shaped right now (positioning, identity, messaging house) and turn it into a brand that holds for the next five years in a market that reinvents itself every quarter.

Our brand stance is that of a pragmatic visionary: bold on vision, precise and evidence-led on capability. You'll be the guardian of that balance, making sure every piece of work speaks the language of the boardroom and holds up to the scrutiny of a CTO/builder.

You'll work hand in hand with leadership, Product, Research, Sales, our FDE teams and Communications, and with our external brand and PR agencies.

What You'll Do

Lead the brand relaunch (Foundations)

  • Take ownership of the new brand platform: positioning, identity, tone of voice and messaging house, and drive its rollout internally and externally.

  • Turn our convictions into a story that is ours: what we believe, why we exist, what makes our approach to enterprise problems unique.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (Platform) - Paris
description:
You'll be joining the team responsible for the infrastructure behind all of H's products: clusters, networking and security. It's the foundation that lets the rest of the company deliver value directly to customers.

What you'll own

From your first quarter, you'll own a real piece of our move from AWS to an environment-agnostic platform. The team moves fast and the problems are novel: each model release and each new customer changes what the infrastructure has to support.

What you'll be doing

  • Running and scaling Kubernetes clusters and networking

  • Building authentication and authorization systems

  • Refactoring the stack to be environment agnostic

  • Speeding up deployment for our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)

  • Building Kubernetes-native services, such as controllers and operators

  • Writing and maintaining infrastructure as code

Your team and your users

The role sits in the Infrastructure team, with our VP of Engineering as hiring manager. Your users are H's product and platform engineers and, through our FDEs, our external customers.

What we think it takes

You're likely a good fit if you:

  • Write Python or Go well enough to solve real problems with it

  • Have built and operated a Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale and can put numbers on its clusters, services and users

title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in w

title: Senior Workday Solution Architect - HR Technology (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As Senior/Expert HR Tech Solution Architect, you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix's global HR technology landscape.

Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization — ensuring our technology enables Flix's future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally.

You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team — including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts — builds within.

This role is based in Berlin, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.  

About the Role

  • Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems — ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements.

title: Software Engineer, Feature Engineering Platform
description:

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Role

We're building a new Feature Engineering Platform that will be the front door to ML development at global scale. As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll help build a seamless experience for ML practitioners across the company — from experimentation and exploration to deployment and monitoring.

Our mission is to make machine learning accessible and intuitive without compromising on power or performance. You'll work on a layered platform that supports both high-level declarative workflows and lower-level imperative APIs, all integrated into the environments our users already work in (like notebooks and internal sandboxes).

  • Build and evolve APIs, SDKs, and platform integrations that power feature engineering workflows.
  • Help shape user-facing tools to make the platform approachable for all skill levels.
  • Collaborate across the ML lifecycle — from data ingestion to feature serving — and integrate tightly with our central Data Control Plane.

title: KYC/AML Associate (all genders)
description:
Mission

Bei der Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft der Integral-Gruppe betreuen wir Unternehmen digital, von der Finanzbuchhaltung über den Jahresabschluss bis zur Steuererklärung. Geldwäscheprävention ist für uns ein Qualitätsversprechen gegenüber unseren Mandant:innen und der Aufsicht, keine Formalie.

Als KYC/AML Associate sorgst du dafür, dass wir nur Mandate annehmen und fortführen, die geldwäscherechtlich einwandfrei sind. Damit bist du eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Mandatsannahme, Berufsrecht und Technologie. Du führst die KYC- und GwG-Prüfungen eigenständig durch, bereitest die Annahmeentscheidungen für unsere Berufsträger:innen vor und entwickelst unsere Prozesse weiter. Digitale Tools und KI nehmen dir dabei Routine ab und schaffen Raum für die eigentliche Risikobewertung. Wenn du Prozesse gern hinterfragst, präzise arbeitest und Lust auf ein technologiegetriebenes Umfeld hast, passt du zu uns.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Geldwäscherechtliche Prüfung bei Mandatsannahme: Identifizierung, Ermittlung der wirtschaftlich Berechtigten inkl. Abgleich mit dem Transparenzregister, PEP- und Sanktionsscreening, Risikoeinstufung und Dokumentation nach GwG und unseren Arbeitsanweisungen

  • Laufende Überwachung des Mandantenbestands und risikoorientierte Aktualisierung der KYC-Daten

  • Erkennen von Auffälligkeiten und interne Meldung an den Geldwäsche-Verantwortlichen; Vorbereitung von Unstimmigkeits- und Verdachtsmeldungen

description:
Empower every employee.

Flip is the leading AI-powered employee experience platform for frontline workers. We're transforming how people do their jobs across the industries that keep the world running: retail, manufacturing, and logistics. One app. One touch. Everything they need.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

AI orchestration is at the centre of where Flip is going. Fusion, a multi-agent code-generation system sits at the core of our newest product, and our Ask AI agent gateway and Flip Flows automation both run on capabilities our AI engineers build and maintain.

As Lead AI Engineer you take over the AI discipline: you own the how (architecture, standards, technical direction) across all three surfaces, you lead and grow a team of three AI engineers, and you stay hands-on where the problems are hardest.

What you can expect

  • Own the AI architecture: Define and align a coherent AI architecture and set of standards across Flip Fusion, Ask AI agent gateway, and Flip Flows.

  • Lead and grow the discipline: Take over people leadership for three AI engineers and help them level up into engineers who set the technical bar themselves.

  • Stay hands-on: Roughly 70 percent of your time stays in the code, on the problems where your judgment matters most.

title: Unsolicited Application (all genders)

  • HubSpot implementation, CRM architecture, and Marketing/Sales/Service Hub expertise

title: Sales Manager
description:
Your Impact

We have built a sales machine that works: ~90% of our AEs hit quota, our top performers achieve significantly more, we rarely lose head to head, and almost nobody who buys Tacto ever leaves. The bottleneck is no longer the market or the product, it is leadership capacity. We need managers who can turn good AEs into great ones at the speed we are hiring them.

As Sales Manager you own one customer segment and lead a team of ~5 Account Executives. You carry no personal quota. Your number is your team's number, and your job is the thing that produces it: the quality of your people, the rigor of your deal strategy, and the discipline of your pipeline. You will work directly with the founders and sales leadership on how we go to market in a segment where over 10,000 industrial companies in DACH still run procurement on Excel, and where we are the category of one.

Your Tasks

  • Own your segment's number through your team: You are measured on team attainment. You build the pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and win rates that make the number inevitable.

  • Team Development: Build and coach a high-performing sales team through structured training, hands-on deal support, and performance management. You'll model best practices while developing each team member's capabilities.

  • Deal Strategy & Execution: Actively join critical customer conversations, challenge assumptions, eliminate risks, and design winning game plans alongside your AEs. You'll roll up your sleeves to support negotiations and business case development.

title: Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Efficiency Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

Wir sind eine spezialisierte Beratung, die innovative Startups und Mittelständler dabei unterstützt, Fördermittel zu erschließen. Für unser wachsendes Team suchen wir einen Student Consultant, der Lust hat, direkt an der Schnittstelle von Innovation, Wissenschaft und Unternehmertum zu arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse und Aufbereitung von Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten unserer Kunden
  • Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Anträgen zur Forschungszulage
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführungen und Gründerteams
  • Recherche zu förderfähigen Maßnahmen und technischen Sachverhalten
  • Unterstützung bei der Dokumentation und Kommunikation mit Förderbehörden

Qualifikation

Du studierst (oder hast kürzlich abgeschlossen) in einem der folgenden Bereiche: Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder Volkswirtschaftslehre. Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst analytisch und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und präzise formulieren. Erste Erfahrungen im Beratungsumfeld oder mit Förderanträgen sind ein Plus – aber kein Muss.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • 100 % Remote – du arbeitest von wo du am produktivsten bist
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
  • Echte Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an
  • Einblick in spannende Innovationsprojekte aus erster Hand

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu dir – wir melden uns schnell unkompliziert und persönlich.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer

As our Senior Analytics Engineer for Operations, you'll own that data end to end, the model behind it, the metrics it produces, and the trust the business places in both.

This role isn't just "build the metric, ship the dashboard." We want someone who looks past the number to the process behind it, where it's manual, where it's fragile, where the right tool removes the work instead of just reporting on it. You'll have a direct line to influencing how those processes and the surrounding product actually work, not just how they're measured.

You'll sit embedded inside Operations, partnering with the TRI (Trust & Risk Intelligence) domain wherever the two overlap, while working inside the Data & Analytics team's AE guild — so you'll have the tools and the context to actually contribute, not just execute.

What You Will Be Doing

Own the Operations data model — reconciliation, treasury, payments, lifecycle, and onboarding — turning raw operational events into documented, trustworthy data products on the DWH

Your mission

Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. description: Job Description    Får du energi af at se andre lykkes? Trives du med at stå i spidsen for den daglige drift i en kundeservicefunktion? Og motiveres du af at finde smartere måder at arbejde på?  Så er du måske vores nye Manager for Customer Care Advanced.   De fleste forbinder Circle K med et hurtigt pitstop, en kaffe på farten eller en hotdog. Men bag det velkendte brand ligger en stor B2B-forretning med kunder og opgaver, der kræver specialistviden, gode løsninger og tæt samarbejde. Og her kommer du ind i billedet.   Tæt på driften, menneskerne og resultaterne   Du får ledelsesansvaret for ni specialister i den danske kundeservice, hvor I sammen sikrer professionelle kundeoplevelser og løsninger af høj kvalitet. Som leder bliver du en central del af kundeservicens daglige maskinrum, hvor du skaber overblik, prioriterer opgaverne og hjælper teamet med at lykkes, også når sagerne er komplekse, eller tempoet er højt. De øvrige 3 er specialister i B2B-kort og håndterer blandt andet komplekse problemstillinger for speditør- og leasingkunder.  Derudover får du det overordnede ansvar for 6 studentermedarbejdere, som bemander afdelingen om eftermiddagen, aftenen og i weekenden.   Du får mennesker og drift til at lykkes   Du har erfaring med kundeservice, gerne B2B, og skaber tydelige rammer, retning og opfølgning. Du formår at bringe teamets kompetencer i spil, og ledelseserfaring er derfor en fordel.  En vigtig del af rollen er at finde smartere løsninger, fx ved at forenkle arbejdsgange, arbejde med den digitale udvikling eller styrke samarbejdet mellem Customer Care, Sales, Distribution og IT. Du skal ikke selv udvikle løsningerne, men være nysgerrig, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte data til konkrete forbedringer. Du har derfor gerne erfaring med CRM-systemer som Salesforce og værktøjer som Power BI.   5 Days Together – fordi vi tror på nærvær og fællesskab   Hos Circle K tror vi på, at den bedste energi opstår, når vi er sammen. Derfor arbejder vi fem dage om ugen fra kontoret, hvor nærvær og tæt samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen.  Din nærmeste leder bliver Senior Manager, After Sales DK, Rikke Voigt Lykke, som tror på frihed under ansvar og på at være tæt på sine medarbejdere. title: Strategic Account Manager 3 - German Speaker
description: About Behavox   Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.  From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.  Our approach is unique, and it’s validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.  We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.   We are looking for a candidate who can speak German. You will oversee some accounts in Italy and Germany for this role.     About The Role   Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.  Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships. title: Account Manager, Workshop
description: Note:  Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.   🚀 Our Story  Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.  Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. title: Client Manager

Our important work benefits our clients and partners as much as it does our people and communities across the globe. We are responsible and reliable, we keep our promises and maintain open and frank communication. That is how we do business. In this genuine client-focused role, you will lead and coach junior staff members, ensuring their professional development and success. Your high emotional intelligence and exceptional coaching skills will be key to fostering a supportive and productive team environment. description: Drømmer du om et lederjob, hvor din indsats bliver værdsat, du arbejder målrettet mod resultaterne, og dine medarbejdere er top engagerede med høj faglighed ?   “Service B2B” er ansvarlig for G4S’ erhvervskunder, fordelt på 4 afdelinger på tværs af Danmark. Vi søger lige nu den leder, der skal have ansvaret for en del af vores erhvervskunder på Sjælland. Du vil få ansvaret for udekørende montører (elektrikere) samt kontorpersonale.   Jobbet    Du er en succes, når din afdeling og dine montører er en succes. Du har dine egne målsætninger, som du har friheden til og ansvaret for at sikre opnåelse af.  Dine montører er udekørende, så distanceledelse er i fokus. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du formår, at motivere det bedste frem i dine medarbejdere, via en kommunikerende og nærværende lederstil.  Du har kundekontakt, håndterer kundehenvendelser og deltager i kundemøder.  Du har et tæt samarbejde med kollegerne i Service B2B, samt de øvrige drifts- og salgsafdelinger, hvor I får sikret den optimale drift, gode kundeoplevelser samt vækst i omsætning og bundlinje.   Hvem er du?     Du er en erfaren personaleleder, og har evt. erfaring med ledelse af elektrikere i sikringsbranchen.  Du er uddannet elektriker/elinstallatør.  Du ser det som din vigtigste opgave, at fjerne de hindringer der ligger på vejen mod succes, og du skaber strukturer i uorden.  Din kommunikation er situationsbestemt, tydelig og diplomatisk.  Du er drevet af at skabe resultater, og har øje for hvordan din ledelse præger din afdelings evne til at nå målene - alt starter med dig.  Du forstår sammenhængen mellem afdelingens mål, virksomhedens bundlinje og dine muligheder for at påvirke dette.     What's in it for you?   Du har nu en unik chance for at blive en del af Danmarks stærkeste hold inden for sikkerhedsløsninger.  Du får stor indflydelse på afdelingens videre udvikling, en afvekslende hverdag og en stærk organisation i ryggen med gode muligheder for faglig og personlig sparring.  Lønpakken forhandles individuelt efter kvalifikationer og består af en fast gage, pensionsordning samt sundhedsordning.  Bemærk at stillingen indebærer erhvervsmæssig kørsel, hvor du stiller egen bil til rådighed og afregnes efter statens takster.  Da G4S er en sikkerhedsvirksomhed, er det en forudsætning, at du kan godkendes af politiet, jf. lov om vagtvirksomhed.   Kontakt:  Spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt Servicechef Nisreen Mahdi på telefon: 24 37 35 31   Frister og rekrutteringsprocessen:  Ansøgninger vurderes og samtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen tages ned, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.   Tiltrædelse:  Snarest muligt, efter aftale.   Vi gør opmærksom på at G4S udelukkende benytter elektronisk rekruttering og det er således kun muligt at søge stillingen online via nedenstående link. Ansøgninger sendt via mail eller post kommer ikke i betragtning.

description: Helsingin kouluterveydenhuolto ja opiskeluterveydenhuolto yhdistyvät 1.1.2027. Tule meille palveluesihenkilöksi rakentamaan uutta organisaatiota. Tehtäviä on avoinna kaksi (2), joista yksi on uusi tehtävä ja yksi avoinna eläköitymisen vuoksi. Tehtävät sijoittuvat kouluterveydenhuoltoon ja opiskeluterveydenhuollon keskitettyihin palveluihin.  Oletko innostava, tiedolla johtava, näkemyksellinen ja rohkea esihenkilö, joka nauttii ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä? Tällöin voit olla etsimämme henkilö.  Esihenkilönä vastaat henkilöstön johtamisesta ja toiminnan kehittämisestä. Toimit lähiesihenkilönä eri kouluissa tai oppilaitoksissa työskenteleville terveydenhuollon ammattilaisille. Kouluterveydenhuollon palveluesihenkilönä johdat peruskouluissa työskentelevien terveydenhoitajien tiimiä. Opiskeluterveydenhuollon palveluesihenkilönä puolestaan johdat tiimiä, jossa työskentelee toisen asteen oppilaitoksissa työskenteleviä terveydenhoitajia, mielenterveys- ja päihdesairaanhoitajia sekä lähihoitajia. Palveluesihenkilöt toimivat lähiesihenkilönä noin 25 työntekijälle.  Etsimme joukkoomme esihenkilöä, joka valmentavan johtamisen keinoin tukee henkilöstöä yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa. Johdat määrätietoisesti, mutta samalla kuuntelet, kannustat ja luot tilaa osaamisen hyödyntämiselle. Tehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää kykyä yhdistää strateginen ajattelu käytännön johtamistyöhön sekä taitoa luoda edellytyksiä henkilöstön onnistumiselle.  Ensi vuoden alusta Helsingin koulu- ja opiskeluterveydenhuolto on osa lapsiperheiden hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluja. Yksikössä työskentelee kaikkiaan yli 250 ammattilaista. Henkilöstö työskentelee pääsääntöisesti eri puolilla Helsinkiä sijaitsevissa kouluissa ja oppilaitoksissa.  Työpiste sijaitsee Lintulassa, Sörnäisissä. Työ sisältää jonkin verran liikkumista eri toimipisteissä ja etätyö on osittain mahdollista.  Videohaastattelukutsut lähetetään viikolla 44. Yksilöhaastattelut järjestetään keskiviikkona 4.11 Töölössä Kivelän sairaalan rakennuksessa.  Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja vaihtelevan työn lisäksi laajat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet. Kaupungin työntekijänä voit hakea vuokra-asuntoa Auroranlinnalta, jonka asunnot ovat markkinatasoa edullisempia ja työntekijöidemme asuntohakemukset etusijalla.  Koska elämä ei ole pelkkää työtä, meillä huolehditaan myös työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainosta. Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden sisältäen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Käytettävissä oleva saldo määräytyy työsuhteesi pituuden perusteella. Lisäksi käytettävissäsi on lounasetu. Saat käyttöösi henkilöstöetuna myös kaupunkipyörän ja voit halutessasi vierailla kaupungin työntekijöiden omalla virkistyssaarella. title: Customer Experience Customer Success Specialist, Splunk
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Meet the Team   The Customer Experience team is focused on helping customers achieve long-term success with their Splunk investment by ensuring the technical health, performance, and adoption of their environments. The team works closely with customers and internal cross-functional partners, including Technical Support, Professional Services, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering, to deliver a seamless and value-driven customer experience. This is a highly collaborative, customer-focused team made up of technical specialists who combine platform expertise with strong relationship management skills. What makes this team exciting is the opportunity to influence customer outcomes directly, solve complex technical challenges, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.   Your Impact   Advise customers on the technical health of their Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud environments to support successful adoption and long-term value realization. Deliver onboarding guidance, enablement planning, and customer workshops to help customers build capability and optimize platform usage. Monitor customer environment health by reviewing cases, outages, critical issues, and ongoing projects, and conduct diagnostic health checks where needed. Partner with internal teams to manage escalations, recommend upgrades, support workload optimization, and ensure customers are informed about product changes, maintenance windows, and new feature availability in line with product roadmaps. Contribute to stronger customer relationships by translating customer needs into actionable insights for account teams and advocating internally to drive effective issue resolution. Participate in sales QBRs with customers (onsite and virtually) to review service levels, usage metrics and customer environment performance. title: Project Specialist, DSV Global Projects and Industry Solutions
description: Haluatko olla mukana kasvattamassa DSV:n Air & Sea -projektiliiketoimintaa Suomessa? DSV on yksi maailman johtavista kuljetus- ja logistiikka-alan toimijoista. Noin 160 000 työntekijäämme yli 90 maassa pitävät toimitusketjut liikkeessä maalla, merellä ja ilmassa. Yhdistämme maailmanlaajuisen verkoston, paikallisen asiantuntemuksen ja vahvan palvelukulttuurin ratkaisuiksi, jotka vievät asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaa eteenpäin.  Haemme Vantaan toimipisteeseemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen  Project Specialistia  projektiliiketoimintaamme. title: Sales Manager – Electrical Generators & Transformers
description: About The Role:   We are looking for an experienced Sales Manager – Electrical Generators & Transformers to lead and manage the sales department for generators, transformers, and related electrical power solutions.  The ideal candidate must be a U.D.P.A. Certified Grade A Electrical Engineer with relevant Kahramaa certification/approval and a minimum of 15 years of experience in the electrical power sector.  The role requires strong technical knowledge of generators, transformers, electrical distribution systems, and Qatar authority requirements, along with proven experience in sales management, business development, tendering, client management, and department leadership.      Key Responsiblities:    Lead and manage the sales department for electrical generators, transformers, and related power solutions.  Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue, profitability, and market-growth targets.  Manage wholesale sales activities for generators, transformers, and associated electrical equipment.  Identify and develop new business opportunities across government, infrastructure, construction, industrial, and commercial sectors.  Build and maintain strong relationships with consultants, contractors, developers, government entities, suppliers, and key clients.  Manage key accounts and maintain long-term customer relationships.  Prepare sales forecasts, annual budgets, business plans, and departmental targets.  Lead commercial negotiations for major projects, supply agreements, and long-term contracts.  Review client specifications, BOQs, tender documents, technical drawings, and project requirements.  Coordinate and review technical and commercial proposals, quotations, pricing, and delivery schedules.  Manage tender submissions, vendor registrations, prequalification, and product approval processes.  Ensure products and technical solutions comply with project specifications, Kahramaa requirements, and applicable international standards.  Provide technical-commercial guidance for generator and transformer selection, sizing, and application.  Coordinate with manufacturers, suppliers, procurement, logistics, finance, and project teams.  Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and supply agreements with manufacturers and suppliers.  Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and customer demand.  Develop strategies to increase market share and expand the company's electrical power solutions business.  Manage, guide, and evaluate sales engineers and sales executives within the department.  Establish team KPIs and monitor departmental sales performance.  Conduct client meetings, technical presentations, negotiations, and project discussions.  Follow up on quotations, purchase orders, deliveries, payments, and outstanding receivables.  Prepare regular sales and business-development reports for senior management.       Requirements:    Bachelor's Degree in  Electrical Engineering  from a recognized university.  Must be a  U.D.P.A.

title: Myyntipäällikkö, Raideliikenteen järjestelmät | Sales Manager, Onboard Systems
description: Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä tulevaisuuden raideliikenteen järjestelmiä kansainvälisillä markkinoilla?     Etsimme Onboard Systems -liiketoimintaamme kokenutta ja tavoitteellista Myyntipäällikköä (Sales Manager) vastaamaan kansainvälisten asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä, uusasiakashankinnasta sekä myyntitiimin vetämisestä. Tässä roolissa yhdistyvät strateginen liiketoiminnan kehittäminen, kansainvälinen myyntityö sekä tiimin johtaminen.     Tarjoamme kattavat henkilöstöedut sekä mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan oppimiseen tehtävässäsi. Lisäksi tarjoamme joustavat työajat ja miellyttävän työympäristön. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää säännöllistä läsnäoloa yhtiön päätoimipisteellä Forssassa mutta pääasiallinen työpaikka voi olla myös Helsinki, Kaarina tai Tampere.     Pääasialliset työtehtäväsi:   Vastaat nimettyjen kansainvälisten markkina-alueiden asiakkuuksista ja uusasiakashankinnasta.  Johdat kaupallisten tarjousten, sopimusten ja projektien suunnittelua sekä neuvotteluja yhteistyössä asiantuntijaorganisaation kanssa.  Vastaat tarjousprosessien toteutuksesta sekä tarjouskannan ja CRM-järjestelmän ylläpidosta.  Kehität ja syvennät yhteistyötä nykyisten asiakkaiden kanssa sekä tunnistat uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia.  Kartoitat uusia markkinoita, analysoit kilpailutilannetta ja osallistut myyntistrategian rakentamiseen.  Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä johdon, tuotekehityksen sekä muiden liiketoimintojen kanssa.  Vastaat asiakkuuksiin, sopimuksiin ja projekteihin liittyvän dokumentaation sekä raportoinnin laadusta.  Johdat Onboard Systems -myyntitiimin päivittäistä toimintaa ja osallistut sen kehittämiseen.  Edustat yritystä asiakastapaamisissa, messuilla ja muissa sidosryhmätilaisuuksissa.      Toivomme sinulta:   Soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa.  Vahvaa kokemusta kansainvälisestä B2B-myynnistä, uusasiakashankinnasta sekä asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä.  Kokemusta teknisten tuotteiden tai järjestelmäratkaisujen myynnistä. title: Client Director - Customer Success Manager
description: 💜 About Us   At Loyal Guru, we help enterprise retailers, grocers, and financial institutions unlock the power of customer loyalty. Our SaaS platform empowers brands to increase repeat purchase revenue, reduce churn, and deliver personalized experiences that drive long-term growth. We are in a strong scale-up phase, rapidly expanding across Europe and Latin America, and we are looking for talented individuals to help us continue this journey.      🎯 About the Role   We are looking for a Customer Success Director – Strategy & Performance to lead our customer strategy with the goal of maximizing satisfaction, retention, and profitability. This is a key leadership role responsible for driving strategic and operational excellence across the Customer Success function. You will oversee Client Directors and their teams, and work closely with the COO and cross-functional teams to align goals and execute customer-centric strategies. Collaborate closely with the COO and other department leaders (Product, Sales, Operations) to ensure strategic and operational alignment with overall company goals.       ✅ What we're looking for in you    8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Strategic Consulting, or Account Management, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into strategic decisions.  Outstanding leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. title: Head of Claims Professional Services
description: Why this role matters  Insurance claims are where promises become reality.  At RGI, we're shaping the future of Claims transformation for some of Europe's most demanding insurance organisations. We are looking for an exceptional leader to drive our Claims Professional Services practice and help insurers modernise one of the most complex and business-critical areas of their operations.  This is not a traditional consulting role.  This is an opportunity to become the reference point for Claims transformation initiatives, leading strategic programmes, influencing executive stakeholders, and guiding highly specialised teams delivering enterprise-scale solutions across the insurance market.  The challenge  As Head of Claims Professional Services, you will take ownership of our Claims delivery practice, acting as the bridge between insurance business strategy, operational excellence, and technology execution.  You will work with senior client stakeholders, support the successful delivery of complex transformation programmes, and lead multidisciplinary teams of analysts, consultants, and subject matter experts. What you will do    Lead the Professional Services practice focused on Claims transformation initiatives.  Act as a trusted advisor for senior insurance executives and business stakeholders.  Drive the successful delivery of complex Claims programmes from strategic design through implementation.  Guide and mentor highly skilled functional consultants and business analysts.  Support pre-sales initiatives by providing deep industry expertise and helping define transformation roadmaps.  Ensure projects deliver tangible business value, operational efficiency and customer-centric outcomes.  Manage challenging stakeholder environments and facilitate high-level decision-making processes.  Contribute to the evolution of RGI's Claims offering by bringing market insights, best practices and innovation ideas.  Build strong, long-term relationships with insurance clients and key industry stakeholders.    Who you are  You are recognised as a Claims expert by your peers.  You have spent a significant part of your career helping insurers improve, transform or modernise their Claims operations and systems. You combine deep domain expertise with strong leadership skills and the credibility required to influence senior decision-makers.  You understand not only technology, but also the business, operational and regulatory complexities that make Claims one of the most strategic functions within an insurance company.  What we are looking for    15+ years of experience within the insurance industry, with a strong focus on Claims.  Extensive knowledge of end-to-end Claims processes across Property & Casualty insurance.  Proven track record leading large Claims transformation or mode

title: Merchant Success Manager
description: Merchant Success Manager      Help our merchant customers get the most value out of everything that comes back     We give returned products a second life at scale, and more and more merchants work with us — from Nordic telecoms and electronics retailers like DNA and Verkkokauppa.com to furniture, DIY and home brands across Europe. Our merchant acquisition team brings new customers on board; you make sure they get the full value of Renow from day one.     You get them up and running, you know how they're doing before they do, and you find new ways we can help them. You also keep our AI sales machine, the one that finds the next customers, running smoothly.      How we work at Renow      Renow is an agentic recommerce platform that connects retailers, merchants and 3PLs through partner warehouses and automated grading. Merchants and retailers send us their returns, trade-ins and buyback volumes; we turn what is usually a cost centre into a profit centre and help consumers buy quality second-hand products from brands they trust. We're on a mission to make recommerce mainstream.     Our team is small and sharp. We move fast, AI is embedded to everything we do and we expect people to take ownership of outcomes rather than tasks. We're backed by respected investors and in a growth phase that means new markets and new partners across Europe.      Is this for you?      - You measure success in the value your merchants get, not in meetings held.  - You've helped a customer discover something they didn't know they needed.  - You'd rather pick up the phone than wait for a problem to show up in a report.  - You use AI every day and let it take the repetitive work, so you have more time for people.  - You prefer startup speed over corporate process.     Tick most yes? Here's what the role looks like.      What you'll do       Get merchants up and running.  Kick-off walkthroughs, onboarding into our tools and logistics, and the first 90 days until their returns flow to us steadily.      Grow together.  Understand each merchant's business and find where we can help more: more categories, more countries, trade-in, buyback, excess stock. Bring the bigger opportunities to our merchant acquisition team and work them together.      Keep them happy.  Measure customer satisfaction and the value they get from us, run regular reviews, and act on what you hear.      Be the human connection.  Our tools already sit inside our merchant customers' returns flow. You build the relationships across their organisation that keep Renow the obvious choice.      Scale it.  Not every customer needs a monthly meeting. Use automation and AI to follow how smaller customers are doing and keep them engaged. Then write the playbook so it works in every market.      Run our AI sales machine.  Keep our automated outreach (email, LinkedIn, AI calls) and CRM running for the merchant acquisition team, and make it better every month.      What we're looking for       Experience.  2–5 years

title: Direct Sales Operations Manager
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     Direct Sales Team은 전국 가맹점에 토스플레이스의 결제 단말기와 매장 관리 솔루션을 설치하고, 매장 사장님들이 토스플레이스 서비스를 가장 빠르게 경험할 수 있도록 모든 과정을 책임지는 팀이에요.  사장님들의 목소리에 귀기울이며, 오프라인 비즈니스의 문제를 기술로 해결하는 최전선에 있어요.  지금 Direct Sales Team은 빠르게 성장하는 시기예요. 세일즈 담당자들이 현장에서 더 빠르고 효율적으로 영역을 전개할 수 있도록, 세일즈 전후의 프로세스, 팀의 성과 점검 체계, 타 조직과의 협업 방식 등 구조와 방향성을 함께 만들어야 합니다.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요     팀의 영업 성과 향상을 위해 최적의 영업 동선을 짜고, 지역·업종을 고려한 우선순위와 방문 시간대 등 영업 전략을 만드는 역할을 담당해요.  영업 전 단계에서 참고할 수 있도록 매장 환경과 상권 특성, 사전 확인사항을 파악하여 세일즈 담당자에게 전파해요.  영업 성공여부, 거절 사유 등을 분석하여 팀 내 우선순위를 조정하거나 가맹점의 동의를 얻어낼 수 있는 영업 방식을 Direct Sales Manager와 함께 고민해요.  가맹점별 VAN대리점 배정부터 설치 완료까지 영업 전후를 포함한 전체 프로세스를 설계하고 운영해요.  설치 지연 패턴을 분석하고 병목 구간을 찾아, 데이터 기반으로 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선해요.  Enterprise Sales Team, Channel Sales Team 등 타 세일즈 조직과 협업하며, 최선의 의사결정을 주도하고 빠르게 가맹점 설치·결제가 일어날 수 있도록 소통해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     세일즈 조직에서 영업 전략·영업 관리·영업 기획 등의 업무를 5년 이상 수행해 오신 분을 찾고 있어요.  가맹점주, 세일즈 조직, 세일즈 이네이블먼트 조직 등 여러 이해관계자와 동시에 소통하며 업무를 조율하고, 매끄러운 협업 경험을 만들어 오신 분이 필요해요.  POS, 키오스크, 결제 단말기 등 오프라인 디바이스에 대한 이해를 갖추셨거나 매장 환경에 대해 이해하고 계신 분이면 더 좋아요.  배달 플랫폼, 결제사, 포스사, 오더사 등 매장 관련 도메인에서 일해보신 분이라면 더 빠르게 적응하실 수 있을거에요.  현장의 목소리와 정량적 수치 양쪽에 모두 관심을 가지고 현상을 파악하실 수 있는 분이여야 해요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성해 주세요     팀의 영업 전략을 수립한 경험을 공유해 주세요. 어떤 문제의식이 있었고, 어떤 해결방법을 택하셨는지, 어떤 지표로 성과를 측정했는지 구체적으로 적어주세요.  이해관계자 간 이견이 있을 때 어떻게 조율했는지, 실제 사례를 들어 설명해주세요.  운영 프로세스를 개선해서 효율을 높인 경험이 있다면, Before/After를 수치로 보여주세요.  빠르게 변하는 상황에서 우선순위를 정하고 실행한 경험을 구체적으로 작성해주세요       토스플레이스로의 합류여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사

title: Workflow Developer & Tester
description:
Description

  • Implement Temporal workflow activities in Go: HSS adapter, PCRF adapter, Inventory update.
  • Build and validate unit tests for all workflow activities from day one.
  • Build the Inventory Management Database: tables, indexes, partitioning for 30M records.
  • Build bulk import tooling: CSV → ICCID/IMSI/MSISDN range ingestion from vendor.
  • Implement REST API endpoints for Inventory DB (allocate, reserve, release, query SIM records).
  • Write integration tests: workflow → mock NE → database assertions.
  • Support Sr. Developer on all workflow development tasks — pair programming expected.
  • End-to-end test suite: full provisioning flow from SIM activation to order closed.
  • Load and stress testing: simulate peak TPS provisioning against all systems.
  • Test automation: CI pipeline integration for all workflow and API tests.
  • HSS sync integration: IMSI allocation state reflected in HSS (mock → real NE).
  • MNP (number portability) hooks in Inventory DB.
  • UAT support: reproduce bugs, write regression tests, validate fixes.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 2–4 years backend software development in production environments.
  • Go or Java — primary development language for this role is Go.
  • Java accepted if strong fundamentals and willing to work in Go (we will support the transition).
  • REST API development — building APIs consumed by other services and tested by automated suites.
  • PostgreSQL — table design, indexes, writing queries, understanding query plans .
  • Unit and integration testing — writing tests is a first-class responsibility, not an afterthought.
  • Git — branching, pull requests, code review participation.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures using RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Redis Pub/Sub.
  • Basic Kubernetes knowledge — understanding how your workloads are deployed.
  • Ability to work under technical direction of a senior lead and execute quickly.
  • Fluent English.

Strong Advantage

  • * Any workflow engine experience: Temporal, Camunda, Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions.
  • * Telecom or BSS/OSS background — understanding of SIM lifecycle, provisioning, activation.
  • * Test framework experience: Go testing, Testify, mock frameworks.
  • * Load testing tools: k6, Locust, JMeter — running and interpreting results.
  • * Docker — building and running containerised services.
  • * Experience with event-sourced or append-only database patterns.

Nice to Have

  • Temporal.io SDK experience — even personal/side project counts.
  • Python — useful for scripting, test tooling, data processing.
  • Prometheus — understanding how to instrument code with metrics.
  • Telecom protocol familiarity: Diameter, SS7, SMPP.

title: Entwicklungsingenieur:in Elektrische Heizsysteme / Prozessgaserhitzer (w/m/d)
description:
Über Hyca Heat

Hyca Heat ist ein deutsches Deep-Tech-Startup an der Spitze der industriellen Energiewende. Wir entwickeln eine weltweit einzigartige, patentierte Heiztechnologie, die hocheffiziente katalytische Verbrennung mit elektrischer Beheizung kombiniert, und dekarbonisieren damit die Prozesswärmeindustrie. Unser Team aus erfahrenen Ingenieuren, Unternehmern und Wissenschaftlern arbeitet in Jülich an einer der größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit.

Deine Mission

Wir suchen eine:n erfahrene:n Ingenieur:in für die Auslegung und Entwicklung elektrischer Hochtemperatur-Heizsysteme (w/m/d) für unser Team in Jülich. Hybrid-Position mit in der Regel 1–2 Homeoffice-Tagen pro Woche.

Du verantwortest das Herzstück unserer Anlagen: die elektrische Widerstandsheizung unserer Prozessgaserhitzer. Die Besonderheit unserer Technologie: Der Heizleiter ist zugleich die Trägerstruktur des Katalysators – elektrische Beheizung, Wärmeübertragung und katalytische Verbrennung finden in einem einzigen Bauteil statt. Geometrie, Werkstoff, Temperaturprofil und Beschichtung lassen sich nicht unabhängig voneinander optimieren. Genau das macht die Aufgabe anspruchsvoll.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Auslegung elektrischer Widerstandsheizer und Prozessgaserhitzer: Oberflächenbelastung, Heizleitertemperatur, Widerstands- und Leistungsauslegung sowie Wärmeübergang in gasdurchströmten Systemen.
  • Werkstoffauswahl unter realen Atmosphären: FeCrAl und NiCr/Nickelbasis gegen die tatsächliche Gaszusammensetzung – Oxidation, Aufkohlung, Nitrierung, Schwefel- und Wasserdampfeinfluss.
  • Auslegung der Heizleiterstruktur als Katalysatorträger: Zusammenspiel von Geometrie, Oberfläche und Temperaturprofil mit der katalytischen Beschichtung – Beschichtbarkeit, Schichthaftung und Alterung.
  • Thermomechanik und konstruktive Integration: Wärmedehnung und Dehnungsausgleich, Kriechen, Zyklenfestigkeit, Strömungsführung und Vermeidung von Hot-Spots.
