title: Deployment Lead
description: We are supporting a rapidly growing robotics company that is looking for a Deployment Lead to take ownership of multiple customer implementations and build a scalable deployment organization.     This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can operate comfortably between customers, engineering teams, field engineers, product teams, and senior leadership.      What you’ll be doing:    Lead a portfolio of customer deployment and implementation projects from planning through successful delivery.  Coordinate and prioritize Field Engineers across multiple customer engagements.  Monitor project progress, resource allocation, quality, utilization, risks, and delivery outcomes.  Develop and standardize deployment processes, playbooks, operating procedures, and best practices.  Identify recurring challenges across deployments and work with Product and Engineering teams to improve the overall solution.  Coach and develop Field Engineers through technical reviews, customer interactions, regular feedback, and professional development.  Communicate project status, risks, trade-offs, and mitigation plans to senior stakeholders and customers.  Support the hiring, onboarding, and development of future Field Engineering talent.  Balance customer requirements, technical feasibility, commercial priorities, timelines, and available resources.       What we're looking for   You could be a strong fit if you have experience as a:   Deployment Lead / Manager  Implementation Lead  Field Engineering Manager  Solutions Engineering Manager  Forward Deployed Engineer / FDE  Technical Delivery Lead  Customer Engineering Lead       We are particularly interested in people who have:    Experience managing multiple customer-facing technical projects simultaneously.  Experience leading or managing engineers while remaining close to technical delivery.  Strong project prioritization and resource-allocation skills.  Experience working directly with senior customer stakeholders and internal leadership.  A track record of creating or improving deployment processes, implementation frameworks, playbooks, or operating models.  Strong technical judgment and the ability to understand complex product and engineering challenges.  Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.       The ideal profile   We're looking for someone who can move beyond simply delivering individual projects and help build a repeatable, scalable deployment function.      You will be someone who:    Sees patterns across multiple customer deployments.  Turns lessons learned into practical processes and standards.  Enjoys developing engineers and raising the overall capability of a team.  Is comfortable making difficult prioritization and resource decisions.  Can explain technical and commercial trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders.  Acts as an effective bridge between customers, engineering, product, and operations.  Combines a hands-on approach with strong leadership capability.

title: Customer Activation Manager - AI SaaS Onboarding
description: New Zealand-based | Fully remote | Supporting primarily US customers       $75k-$95k      Joyous replaces traditional surveys with  dynamic AI conversations and real-time action .     Instead of simply collecting feedback and producing another report, Joyous can understand what people are saying, ask smarter questions in the moment and help organisations move directly into making changes.     We’re building something genuinely different in a market where almost everyone agrees that surveys are overdue for a rethink.     Joyous already has an impressive product and real traction, including many of the world’s largest telecommunications companies across the US, Europe and New Zealand. But we’re still early in the journey, which means there is a lot left to build, improve and learn.     We’re now expanding into a more repeatable mid-market motion and are looking for a Customer Activation Manager to help us build the simplest possible journey from  signed to live and getting value .        The role     Once a customer signs, you’ll own getting them successfully launched.     You’ll understand what they are trying to achieve, turn it into a simple plan, guide them through setup, coordinate anything required from our team and keep things moving until they are live and confident.     There can be plenty of complexity behind the scenes. Your job is to absorb that complexity rather than pass it on to the customer.     We already have a strong view on what good activation should look like. Your role is to help us turn that into a  simple, repeatable playbook that works across lots of customers without feeling like a process factory .     Over time we want to go further than documenting the process. A big part of the opportunity is spotting what can be  codified into the product itself , so activation becomes increasingly intuitive and scalable rather than depending on a person repeating the same steps.     So you’ll be doing two things at once:      Helping customers get live successfully today, while helping us design a much simpler activation model for tomorrow.       You’ll know you’re winning when customers get from signed to live quickly, confidently and with very little friction, and the process becomes increasingly repeatable as we learn.         Who we’re looking for     You could come from customer success, implementation, account management, consulting or another customer-facing role.
